units.title: Relationships and emotions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

ex.zh: 我结婚了，而且有两个孩子。
ex.p: wǒ jié hūn le ér qiě yǒu liǎng gè hái zi
ex.en: I am married and have two children.

ex.zh: 我要的不是茶，而是咖啡。
ex.p: wǒ yào de bù shì chá ér shì kā fēi
ex.en: What I want isn't tea, but coffee.

ex.zh: 他将袜子的里外穿反了。
ex.p: tā jiāng wà zi de lǐ wài chuān fǎn le
ex.en: He had his socks on inside out.

ex.zh: 我不知道我们将会做什么。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ men jiāng huì zuò shén me
ex.en: I don't know what we'll do.

ex.zh: 他最大的缺点就是话太多。
ex.p: tā zuì dà de quē diǎn jiù shì huà tài duō
ex.en: His greatest fault is talking too much.

ex.zh: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。
ex.p: tā zhè me shuō jiù shì wèi le kāi wán xiào
ex.en: He said it merely as a joke.

ex.zh: 她持有与我不同的观点。
ex.p: tā chí yǒu yǔ wǒ bù tóng de guān diǎn
ex.en: She has a view that is different from mine.

ex.zh: 行与行之间多留些空间。
ex.p: xíng yǔ xíng zhī jiān duō liú xiē kōng jiān
ex.en: Leave more space between the lines.

ex.zh: 他觉得我理所应当知道答案。
ex.p: tā jué de wǒ lǐ suǒ yīng dāng zhī dào dá àn
ex.en: He took it for granted that I knew the answer.

ex.zh: 她把我的玩笑当真了。
ex.p: tā bǎ wǒ de wán xiào dàng zhēn le
ex.en: She took my joke seriously.

ex.zh: 你是我最好的朋友之一。
ex.p: nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you zhī yī
ex.en: You're one of my best friends.

ex.zh: 你觉得我之前在做什么？
ex.p: nǐ jué de wǒ zhī qián zài zuò shén me
ex.en: What do you think I've been doing?

ex.zh: 这是一个生和死的问题。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè shēng hé sǐ de wèn tí
ex.en: It's a matter of life and death.

ex.zh: 不管怎样，我们所有人都将死。
ex.p: bù guǎn zěn yàng wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu jiāng sǐ
ex.en: We're all going to die anyway.

items.en: all; to have; to possess; to own

ex.zh: 他的脸失去了所有颜色。
ex.p: tā de liǎn shī qù le suǒ yǒu yán sè
ex.en: His face turned pale.

ex.zh: 我们所有的努力都白费了。
ex.p: wǒ men suǒ yǒu de nǔ lì dōu bái fèi le
ex.en: All our efforts were in vain.

ex.zh: 他会成为一个好的医生的。
ex.p: tā huì chéng wéi yī gè hǎo de yī shēng de
ex.en: He will be a good doctor.

ex.zh: 他长大了会成为一名医生。
ex.p: tā zhǎng dà le huì chéng wéi yī míng yī shēng
ex.en: He will be a doctor when he grows up.

ex.zh: 我从来没感觉那么好过。
ex.p: wǒ cóng lái méi gǎn jué nà me hǎo guò
ex.en: I've never felt better.

ex.zh: 我感觉你想告诉我什么事。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn jué nǐ xiǎng gào sù wǒ shén me shì
ex.en: I get the feeling you're trying to tell me something.

ex.zh: 我们要继续我们的工作。
ex.p: wǒ men yào jì xù wǒ men de gōng zuò
ex.en: We have to continue to do our jobs.

ex.zh: 我没力气继续尝试了。
ex.p: wǒ méi lì qi jì xù cháng shì le
ex.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.

items.en: large place used for a specific purpose; stage

ex.zh: 我会开车送你们去机场。
ex.p: wǒ huì kāi chē sòng nǐ men qù jī chǎng
ex.en: I'll drive you to the airport.

ex.zh: 他全家都在农场工作。
ex.p: tā quán jiā dōu zài nóng chǎng gōng zuò
ex.en: All of his family work on a farm.

ex.zh: 今天太热了，我没心情学习。
ex.p: jīn tiān tài rè le wǒ méi xīn qíng xué xí
ex.en: I don't feel like studying today in this heat.

ex.zh: 今晚我没心情出去吃饭。
ex.p: jīn wǎn wǒ méi xīn qíng chū qù chī fàn
ex.en: I don't feel like eating out this evening.

ex.zh: 该项目正在进行中。
ex.p: gāi xiàng mù zhèng zài jìn xíng zhōng
ex.en: The project is ongoing.

ex.zh: 她现在应该已经到家了。
ex.p: tā xiàn zài yīng gāi yǐ jīng dào jiā le
ex.en: She should have arrived home by now.

ex.zh: 我之前已经来过这里了。
ex.p: wǒ zhī qián yǐ jīng lái guò zhè lǐ le
ex.en: I've been here before.

ex.zh: 您可以在三天内完成吗？
ex.p: nín kě yǐ zài sān tiān nèi wán chéng ma
ex.en: Can you finish this in three days?

ex.zh: 我们必须在五分钟之内离开。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū zài wǔ fēn zhōng zhī nèi lí kāi
ex.en: We have to leave in five minutes.

ex.zh: 一个男的突然出现在门口。
ex.p: yī gè nán de tū rán chū xiàn zài mén kǒu
ex.en: A man suddenly appeared in the doorway.

ex.zh: 一辈子只会出现一次像这样的机会。
ex.p: yī bèi zi zhǐ huì chū xiàn yī cì xiàng zhè yàng de jī huì
ex.en: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.

ex.zh: 他和一个美国女人结婚了。
ex.p: tā hé yī gè měi guó nǚ rén jié hūn le
ex.en: He is married to an American lady.

ex.zh: 你做了一项完美的工作。
ex.p: nǐ zuò le yī xiàng wán měi de gōng zuò
ex.en: You've done a perfect job.

items.en: to pass through; to get through

ex.zh: 我不想不通过考试。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng bù tōng guò kǎo shì
ex.en: I don't want to fail my exams.

ex.zh: 如果他努力学习，他会通过考试的。
ex.p: rú guǒ tā nǔ lì xué xí tā huì tōng guò kǎo shì de
ex.en: If he studied hard, he would pass the test.

ex.zh: 虽然他很有钱，但他不幸福。
ex.p: suī rán tā hěn yǒu qián dàn tā bù xìng fú
ex.en: He's rich, but he's not happy.

ex.zh: 他看起来好像很幸福。
ex.p: tā kàn qǐ lai hǎo xiàng hěn xìng fú
ex.en: He seems quite happy.

ex.zh: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。
ex.p: tā men fēn fáng shuì jí shǐ tā men yǐ jīng jié hūn le
ex.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.

ex.zh: 即使我知道答案，我也不会告诉你。
ex.p: jí shǐ wǒ zhī dào dá àn wǒ yě bù huì gào sù nǐ
ex.en: Even if I knew the answer, I wouldn't tell you.

items.en: no matter what or how; regardless of whether...

ex.zh: 无论我做什么，你都不高兴。
ex.p: wú lùn wǒ zuò shén me nǐ dōu bù gāo xìng
ex.en: You won't be happy no matter what I do.

ex.zh: 无论你要我做什么，我都会去做的。
ex.p: wú lùn nǐ yào wǒ zuò shén me wǒ dū huì qù zuò de
ex.en: I'll do whatever you want me to do.

ex.zh: 大家都玩爱情游戏。
ex.p: dà jiā dōu wán ài qíng yóu xì
ex.en: Everybody plays the game of love.

ex.zh: 我相信爱情。
ex.p: wǒ xiāng xìn ài qíng
ex.en: I believe in love.

ex.zh: 我很抱歉伤害了你的感情。
ex.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn shāng hài le nǐ de gǎn qíng
ex.en: I'm so sorry I hurt your feelings.

ex.zh: 她很容易受到感情上的伤害。
ex.p: tā hěn róng yì shòu dào gǎn qíng shàng de shāng hài
ex.en: Her feelings are easily hurt.

items.en: to leave out; to be missing

ex.zh: 他们在加拿大安家落户。
ex.p: tā men zài jiā ná dà ān jiā luò hù
ex.en: They settled in Canada.

ex.zh: 他把眼镜落在我们这里了。
ex.p: tā bǎ yǎn jìng là zài wǒ men zhè lǐ le
ex.en: He left his glasses at our place.

ex.zh: 他错过了最后一班火车。
ex.p: tā cuò guò le zuì hòu yī bān huǒ chē
ex.en: He missed the last train.

ex.zh: 快点，不然你就要错过火车了。
ex.p: kuài diǎn bù rán nǐ jiù yào cuò guò huǒ chē le
ex.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.

ex.zh: 既然母亲病了，我就待在家里没去上学。
ex.p: jì rán mǔ qīn bìng le wǒ jiù dài zài jiā lǐ méi qù shàng xué
ex.en: Since my mother was sick, I stayed home from school.

items.en: to move emotionally; to stir up (emotions)

ex.zh: 我快要激动得说不出话来了。
ex.p: wǒ kuài yào jī dòng de shuō bù chū huà lái le
ex.en: I'm getting choked up.

ex.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。
ex.p: tài kōng pǎo bù shì lì shǐ shàng jī dòng rén xīn de shí kè
ex.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.

ex.zh: 这个学校的学生很友好。
ex.p: zhè gè xué xiào de xué sheng hěn yǒu hǎo
ex.en: The students of this school are kind.

ex.zh: 你和他都很友好。
ex.p: nǐ hé tā dōu hěn yǒu hǎo
ex.en: You and he are both very kind.

ex.zh: 还有什么比友情更好呢？
ex.p: hái yǒu shén me bǐ yǒu qíng gēng hǎo ne
ex.en: What is better than friendship?

ex.zh: 他们的友情深深地感动了我们。
ex.p: tā men de yǒu qíng shēn shēn de gǎn dòng le wǒ men
ex.en: Their friendship moved us deeply.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第46单元

Relationships and emotions

Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 无论我做什么，你都不高兴。
sents.p: wú lùn wǒ zuò shén me nǐ dōu bù gāo xìng
sents.en: You won't be happy no matter what I do.

sents.zh: 无论你要我做什么，我都会去做的。
sents.p: wú lùn nǐ yào wǒ zuò shén me wǒ dū huì qù zuò de
sents.en: I'll do whatever you want me to do.

sents.zh: 大家都玩爱情游戏。
sents.p: dà jiā dōu wán ài qíng yóu xì
sents.en: Everybody plays the game of love.

sents.zh: 我相信爱情。
sents.p: wǒ xiāng xìn ài qíng
sents.en: I believe in love.

sents.zh: 我很抱歉伤害了你的感情。
sents.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn shāng hài le nǐ de gǎn qíng
sents.en: I'm so sorry I hurt your feelings.

sents.zh: 她很容易受到感情上的伤害。
sents.p: tā hěn róng yì shòu dào gǎn qíng shàng de shāng hài
sents.en: Her feelings are easily hurt.

sents.zh: 他们在加拿大安家落户。
sents.p: tā men zài jiā ná dà ān jiā luò hù
sents.en: They settled in Canada.

sents.zh: 他把眼镜落在我们这里了。
sents.p: tā bǎ yǎn jìng là zài wǒ men zhè lǐ le
sents.en: He left his glasses at our place.

sents.zh: 他错过了最后一班火车。
sents.p: tā cuò guò le zuì hòu yī bān huǒ chē
sents.en: He missed the last train.

sents.zh: 快点，不然你就要错过火车了。
sents.p: kuài diǎn bù rán nǐ jiù yào cuò guò huǒ chē le
sents.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.

sents.zh: 既然母亲病了，我就待在家里没去上学。
sents.p: jì rán mǔ qīn bìng le wǒ jiù dài zài jiā lǐ méi qù shàng xué
sents.en: Since my mother was sick, I stayed home from school.

sents.zh: 我快要激动得说不出话来了。
sents.p: wǒ kuài yào jī dòng de shuō bù chū huà lái le
sents.en: I'm getting choked up.

sents.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。
sents.p: tài kōng pǎo bù shì lì shǐ shàng jī dòng rén xīn de shí kè
sents.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.

sents.zh: 这个学校的学生很友好。
sents.p: zhè gè xué xiào de xué sheng hěn yǒu hǎo
sents.en: The students of this school are kind.

sents.zh: 你和他都很友好。
sents.p: nǐ hé tā dōu hěn yǒu hǎo
sents.en: You and he are both very kind.

sents.zh: 还有什么比友情更好呢？
sents.p: hái yǒu shén me bǐ yǒu qíng gēng hǎo ne
sents.en: What is better than friendship?

sents.zh: 他们的友情深深地感动了我们。
sents.p: tā men de yǒu qíng shēn shēn de gǎn dòng le wǒ men
sents.en: Their friendship moved us deeply.

units.intro: Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

ex.zh: 他们的计划我一无所知。
ex.p: tā men de jì huà wǒ yī wú suǒ zhī
ex.en: I am quite ignorant of their plan.

ex.zh: 她无所事事地看向窗外
ex.p: tā wú suǒ shì shì de kàn xiàng chuāng wài
ex.en: She was idly looking out of the window.

ex.zh: 从现在开始，由她来照顾你。
ex.p: cóng xiàn zài kāi shǐ yóu tā lái zhào gu nǐ
ex.en: She will care for you from now on.

ex.zh: 她有三个孩子，信不信由你。
ex.p: tā yǒu sān gè hái zi xìn bù xìn yóu nǐ
ex.en: Believe it or not, she has three children.

ex.zh: 他这么做，没有任何不安。
ex.p: tā zhè me zuò méi yǒu rèn hé bù ān
ex.en: He had no qualms in doing so.

ex.zh: 你可以做任何你想做的事。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ zuò rèn hé nǐ xiǎng zuò de shì
ex.en: You can do whatever you want to.

ex.zh: 你觉得对此该做什么？
ex.p: nǐ jué de duì cǐ gāi zuò shén me
ex.en: What do you think should be done about it?

ex.zh: 早知如此，就不应该借钱给他。
ex.p: zǎo zhī rú cǐ jiù bù yīng gāi jiè qián gěi tā
ex.en: You should have known better than to lend him money.

ex.zh: 我完全不认识那个女人。
ex.p: wǒ wán quán bù rèn shi nà gè nǚ rén
ex.en: I really don't know that woman.

ex.zh: 我完全相信你是清白的。
ex.p: wǒ wán quán xiāng xìn nǐ shì qīng bái de
ex.en: I am fully convinced of your innocence.

ex.zh: 他使他儿子成了个有钱人。
ex.p: tā shǐ tā ér zi chéng le gè yǒu qián rén
ex.en: He made his son a wealthy man.

ex.zh: 我不知道如何使用它。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào rú hé shǐ yòng tā
ex.en: I don't know how to use it.

ex.zh: 为什么你这么没有安全感？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ zhè me méi yǒu ān quán gǎn
ex.en: Why are you so insecure?

ex.zh: 五岁以下的小孩票价全免。
ex.p: wǔ suì yǐ xià de xiǎo hái piào jià quán miǎn
ex.en: There is no admission fee for children under five.

ex.zh: 哪个队赢得比赛并不重要。
ex.p: nǎ gè duì yíng dé bǐ sài bìng bù zhòng yào
ex.en: It doesn't matter which team wins the game.

ex.zh: 我们选她为我们队的队长。
ex.p: wǒ men xuǎn tā wèi wǒ men duì de duì zhǎng
ex.en: We elected her captain of our team.

ex.zh: 他们是从法国南部来的。
ex.p: tā men shì cóng fǎ guó nán bù lái de
ex.en: They come from the south of France.

ex.zh: 他的故事一部分是真的。
ex.p: tā de gù shì yī bù fen shì zhēn de
ex.en: Part of his story is true.

ex.zh: 有时候成人表现得像儿童。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou chéng rén biǎo xiàn de xiàng ér tóng
ex.en: Sometimes adults behave like children.

ex.zh: 我们很高兴接受你的提议。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng jiē shòu nǐ de tí yì
ex.en: We gladly accept your offer.

ex.zh: 除了接受报价，我别无选择。
ex.p: chú le jiē shòu bào jià wǒ bié wú xuǎn zé
ex.en: I had no choice but to accept the offer.

ex.zh: 其中一个学生今天没来。
ex.p: qí zhōng yī gè xué sheng jīn tiān méi lái
ex.en: One of the students didn't come today.

ex.zh: 我的其中一个行李不见了。
ex.p: wǒ de qí zhōng yī gè xíng li bù jiàn le
ex.en: One of my suitcases is missing.

ex.zh: 行与行之间多留些空间。
ex.p: xíng yǔ xíng zhī jiān duō liú xiē kōng jiān
ex.en: Leave more space between the lines.

ex.zh: 我们之间肯定有误会。
ex.p: wǒ men zhī jiān kěn dìng yǒu wù huì
ex.en: There must be some misunderstanding between us.

ex.zh: “我也那样觉得。”她附和道。
ex.p: wǒ yě nà yàng jué de tā fù hè dào
ex.en: "I think so, too," she chimed in.

ex.zh: 他不知道他自己五音不全。
ex.p: tā bù zhī dào tā zì jǐ wǔ yīn bù quán
ex.en: He doesn't realise that he's tone deaf.

items.en: to be capable of; to be able to

ex.zh: 我自己能够证实那是真的。
ex.p: wǒ zì jǐ néng gòu zhèng shí nà shì zhēn de
ex.en: I can verify that that's the truth myself.

ex.zh: 他努力学习，为的是能够考上大学。
ex.p: tā nǔ lì xué xí wèi de shì néng gòu kǎo shàng dà xué
ex.en: He studied hard in order to get into college.

ex.zh: 学生们无法给出一个答案。
ex.p: xué sheng men wú fǎ gěi chū yī gè dá àn
ex.en: The students could not give an answer.

ex.zh: 我再也无法相信任何人了。
ex.p: wǒ zài yě wú fǎ xiāng xìn rèn hé rén le
ex.en: I can't believe anyone anymore.

items.en: to pull; to play (a bowed instrument)

ex.zh: 要怎么才能把他拉下马？
ex.p: yào zěn me cái néng bǎ tā lā xià mǎ
ex.en: What will it take to bring him down?

ex.zh: 请问您要多来点儿沙拉吗？
ex.p: qǐng wèn nín yào duō lái diǎn ér shā lā ma
ex.en: Would you like a little more salad?

items.en: regarding; as far as (sth) is concerned; with re

ex.zh: 为什么你对于这个有这样的想法？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ duì yú zhè gè yǒu zhè yàng de xiǎng fǎ
ex.en: Why should you think that?

ex.zh: 对于我，我不反对。
ex.p: duì yú wǒ wǒ bù fǎn duì
ex.en: As for me, I have no objection.

ex.zh: 这本小说的作者是谁？
ex.p: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de zuò zhě shì shéi
ex.en: Who's the author of this story?

ex.zh: 听说最近失业者人数正在增加
ex.p: tīng shuō zuì jìn shī yè zhě rén shù zhèng zài zēng jiā
ex.en: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.

ex.zh: 在第一个信号灯处右转。
ex.p: zài dì yī gè xìn hào dēng chù yòu zhuǎn
ex.en: Turn right at the first traffic light.

ex.zh: 请在下一个十字路口右转。
ex.p: qǐng zài xià yī gè shí zì lù kǒu yòu zhuǎn
ex.en: Turn right at the next intersection.

ex.zh: 警察会调查这起案件。
ex.p: jǐng chá huì diào chá zhè qǐ àn jiàn
ex.en: The police will look into the case.

ex.zh: 警察调查事故的原因。
ex.p: jǐng chá diào chá shì gù de yuán yīn
ex.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.

ex.zh: 他适应了新的生活方式。
ex.p: tā shì yìng le xīn de shēng huó fāng shì
ex.en: He got accustomed to the new way of living.

ex.zh: 她不喜欢我说话的方式。
ex.p: tā bù xǐ huan wǒ shuō huà de fāng shì
ex.en: She doesn't like the way I speak.

ex.zh: 他强调都市生活的便利方面。
ex.p: tā qiáng diào dū shì shēng huó de biàn lì fāng miàn
ex.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.

ex.zh: 我想特别强调这一点。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng tè bié qiáng diào zhè yī diǎn
ex.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

ex.zh: 她的房子在河的另一边。
ex.p: tā de fáng zi zài hé de lìng yī biān
ex.en: Her house is across the river.

ex.zh: 很抱歉，我还有另一个约会。
ex.p: hěn bào qiàn wǒ hái yǒu lìng yī gè yuē huì
ex.en: I'm sorry. I have another appointment.

ex.zh: 可那不是真正的问题所在。
ex.p: kě nà bù shì zhēn zhèng de wèn tí suǒ zài
ex.en: But that's not the real problem.

ex.zh: 你真正的目标是什么？
ex.p: nǐ zhēn zhèng de mù biāo shì shén me
ex.en: What's your real goal?

ex.zh: 不管问了什么，她都能回答。
ex.p: bù guǎn wèn le shén me tā dōu néng huí dá
ex.en: She was able to answer whatever was asked.

ex.zh: 不管是谁总比没人好。
ex.p: bù guǎn shì shéi zǒng bǐ méi rén hǎo
ex.en: Anybody would be better than nobody.

ex.zh: 让我知道我是否需要改变。
ex.p: ràng wǒ zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu xū yào gǎi biàn
ex.en: Let me know if I need to change.

ex.zh: 我没法改变昨天发生的事情。
ex.p: wǒ méi fǎ gǎi biàn zuó tiān fā shēng de shì qing
ex.en: I can't change what happened yesterday.

ex.zh: 我不知道我是否有时间做。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu yǒu shí jiān zuò
ex.en: I don't know if I have time to do it.

ex.zh: 谁也不知道他是否爱她。
ex.p: shéi yě bù zhī dào tā shì fǒu ài tā
ex.en: No one knows if he loves her or not.

ex.zh: 一个人只能活七十岁左右。
ex.p: yī gè rén zhǐ néng huó qī shí suì zuǒ yòu
ex.en: Humans only live about 70 years.

ex.zh: 我们在一起生活了三年。
ex.p: wǒ men zài yī qǐ shēng huó le sān nián
ex.en: We lived together for three years.

sents.en: Leave more space between the lines.

sents.zh: 我们之间肯定有误会。
sents.p: wǒ men zhī jiān kěn dìng yǒu wù huì
sents.en: There must be some misunderstanding between us.

sents.zh: “我也那样觉得。”她附和道。
sents.p: wǒ yě nà yàng jué de tā fù hè dào
sents.en: "I think so, too," she chimed in.

sents.zh: 他不知道他自己五音不全。
sents.p: tā bù zhī dào tā zì jǐ wǔ yīn bù quán
sents.en: He doesn't realise that he's tone deaf.

sents.zh: 我自己能够证实那是真的。
sents.p: wǒ zì jǐ néng gòu zhèng shí nà shì zhēn de
sents.en: I can verify that that's the truth myself.

sents.zh: 他努力学习，为的是能够考上大学。
sents.p: tā nǔ lì xué xí wèi de shì néng gòu kǎo shàng dà xué
sents.en: He studied hard in order to get into college.

sents.zh: 学生们无法给出一个答案。
sents.p: xué sheng men wú fǎ gěi chū yī gè dá àn
sents.en: The students could not give an answer.

sents.zh: 我再也无法相信任何人了。
sents.p: wǒ zài yě wú fǎ xiāng xìn rèn hé rén le
sents.en: I can't believe anyone anymore.

sents.zh: 要怎么才能把他拉下马？
sents.p: yào zěn me cái néng bǎ tā lā xià mǎ
sents.en: What will it take to bring him down?

sents.zh: 请问您要多来点儿沙拉吗？
sents.p: qǐng wèn nín yào duō lái diǎn ér shā lā ma
sents.en: Would you like a little more salad?

sents.zh: 为什么你对于这个有这样的想法？
sents.p: wèi shén me nǐ duì yú zhè gè yǒu zhè yàng de xiǎng fǎ
sents.en: Why should you think that?

sents.zh: 对于我，我不反对。
sents.p: duì yú wǒ wǒ bù fǎn duì
sents.en: As for me, I have no objection.

sents.zh: 这本小说的作者是谁？
sents.p: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de zuò zhě shì shéi
sents.en: Who's the author of this story?

sents.zh: 听说最近失业者人数正在增加
sents.p: tīng shuō zuì jìn shī yè zhě rén shù zhèng zài zēng jiā
sents.en: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.

sents.zh: 在第一个信号灯处右转。
sents.p: zài dì yī gè xìn hào dēng chù yòu zhuǎn
sents.en: Turn right at the first traffic light.

sents.zh: 请在下一个十字路口右转。
sents.p: qǐng zài xià yī gè shí zì lù kǒu yòu zhuǎn
sents.en: Turn right at the next intersection.

sents.zh: 警察会调查这起案件。
sents.p: jǐng chá huì diào chá zhè qǐ àn jiàn
sents.en: The police will look into the case.

sents.zh: 警察调查事故的原因。
sents.p: jǐng chá diào chá shì gù de yuán yīn
sents.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.

sents.zh: 他适应了新的生活方式。
sents.p: tā shì yìng le xīn de shēng huó fāng shì
sents.en: He got accustomed to the new way of living.

sents.zh: 她不喜欢我说话的方式。
sents.p: tā bù xǐ huan wǒ shuō huà de fāng shì
sents.en: She doesn't like the way I speak.

sents.zh: 他强调都市生活的便利方面。
sents.p: tā qiáng diào dū shì shēng huó de biàn lì fāng miàn
sents.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.

sents.zh: 我想特别强调这一点。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng tè bié qiáng diào zhè yī diǎn
sents.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

sents.zh: 她的房子在河的另一边。
sents.p: tā de fáng zi zài hé de lìng yī biān
sents.en: Her house is across the river.

sents.zh: 很抱歉，我还有另一个约会。
sents.p: hěn bào qiàn wǒ hái yǒu lìng yī gè yuē huì
sents.en: I'm sorry. I have another appointment.

sents.zh: 可那不是真正的问题所在。
sents.p: kě nà bù shì zhēn zhèng de wèn tí suǒ zài
sents.en: But that's not the real problem.

sents.zh: 你真正的目标是什么？
sents.p: nǐ zhēn zhèng de mù biāo shì shén me
sents.en: What's your real goal?

sents.zh: 不管问了什么，她都能回答。
sents.p: bù guǎn wèn le shén me tā dōu néng huí dá
sents.en: She was able to answer whatever was asked.

sents.zh: 不管是谁总比没人好。
sents.p: bù guǎn shì shéi zǒng bǐ méi rén hǎo
sents.en: Anybody would be better than nobody.

sents.zh: 让我知道我是否需要改变。
sents.p: ràng wǒ zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu xū yào gǎi biàn
sents.en: Let me know if I need to change.

sents.zh: 我没法改变昨天发生的事情。
sents.p: wǒ méi fǎ gǎi biàn zuó tiān fā shēng de shì qing
sents.en: I can't change what happened yesterday.

sents.zh: 我不知道我是否有时间做。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu yǒu shí jiān zuò
sents.en: I don't know if I have time to do it.

sents.zh: 谁也不知道他是否爱她。
sents.p: shéi yě bù zhī dào tā shì fǒu ài tā
sents.en: No one knows if he loves her or not.

sents.zh: 一个人只能活七十岁左右。
sents.p: yī gè rén zhǐ néng huó qī shí suì zuǒ yòu
sents.en: Humans only live about 70 years.

sents.zh: 我们在一起生活了三年。
sents.p: wǒ men zài yī qǐ shēng huó le sān nián
sents.en: We lived together for three years.

units.title: Relationships and emotions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

items.en: to be born; to give birth

ex.zh: 上天会帮助自力更生的人。
ex.p: shàng tiān huì bāng zhù zì lì gēng shēng de rén
ex.en: God helps those who help themselves.

ex.zh: 不要再让这种事发生了！
ex.p: bù yào zài ràng zhè zhǒng shì fā shēng le
ex.en: Don't let that happen again!

ex.zh: 为什么你要烧这些图片呢？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ yào shāo zhè xiē tú piàn ne
ex.en: Why are you burning these pictures?

ex.zh: 他给我们看他母亲的照片。
ex.p: tā gěi wǒ men kàn tā mǔ qīn de zhào piàn
ex.en: He showed us his mother's picture.

ex.zh: 不要自己一个人走回家。
ex.p: bù yào zì jǐ yī gè rén zǒu huí jiā
ex.en: Don't walk home alone.

ex.zh: 人要为自己的行为负责。
ex.p: rén yào wèi zì jǐ de xíng wéi fù zé
ex.en: One must be responsible for one's conduct.

ex.zh: 我弟弟很喜欢拍山的照片。
ex.p: wǒ dì di hěn xǐ huan pāi shān de zhào piàn
ex.en: My brother loves taking pictures of mountains.

ex.zh: 抱歉，这是我的球拍。
ex.p: bào qiàn zhè shì wǒ de qiú pāi
ex.en: Pardon me, but that's my racket.

ex.zh: 我整个下午都在花园里。
ex.p: wǒ zhěng gè xià wǔ dōu zài huā yuán lǐ
ex.en: I was in the garden all afternoon.

ex.zh: 他把整个苹果都吃了。
ex.p: tā bǎ zhěng gè píng guǒ dōu chī le
ex.en: He ate the whole apple.

ex.zh: 用字典查出下面词组的意思。
ex.p: yòng zì diǎn chá chū xià miàn cí zǔ de yì si
ex.en: Use a dictionary to find the meanings of the phrases below.

ex.zh: 一个足球队由十一个球员组成。
ex.p: yī gè zú qiú duì yóu shí yī gè qiú yuán zǔ chéng
ex.en: A soccer team consists of eleven players.

ex.zh: 他一定没有多考虑就说了。
ex.p: tā yī dìng méi yǒu duō kǎo lǜ jiù shuō le
ex.en: He must have said so without giving it much thought.

ex.zh: 你确定他们可以干这个吗？
ex.p: nǐ què dìng tā men kě yǐ gàn zhè gè ma
ex.en: Are you sure they can do this?

ex.zh: 直接和我说我要做什么。
ex.p: zhí jiē hé wǒ shuō wǒ yào zuò shén me
ex.en: Just tell me what I have to do.

ex.zh: 如果您想知道，直接问就是了。
ex.p: rú guǒ nín xiǎng zhī dào zhí jiē wèn jiù shì le
ex.en: If you want to know, just ask.

ex.zh: 你们永远不会一个人的。
ex.p: nǐ men yǒng yuǎn bù huì yī gè rén de
ex.en: You'll never be alone.

ex.zh: 我永远不会忘记您的帮助。
ex.p: wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù huì wàng jì nín de bāng zhù
ex.en: I'll never forget how helpful you've been.

ex.zh: 他强调都市生活的便利方面。
ex.p: tā qiáng diào dū shì shēng huó de biàn lì fāng miàn
ex.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.

ex.zh: 他在这方面不是很严格。
ex.p: tā zài zhè fāng miàn bù shì hěn yán gé
ex.en: He's not very strict about this.

ex.zh: 他和他的姐妹们目前都住在东京。
ex.p: tā hé tā de jiě mèi men mù qián dōu zhù zài dōng jīng
ex.en: He and his sisters are currently living in Tokyo.

ex.zh: 目前我待在酒店。
ex.p: mù qián wǒ dài zài jiǔ diàn
ex.en: I am staying at the hotel for the time being.

ex.zh: 她仔细考虑了他的提议。
ex.p: tā zǐ xì kǎo lǜ le tā de tí yì
ex.en: She considered his offer carefully.

ex.zh: 我们必须考虑到他很年轻。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū kǎo lǜ dào tā hěn nián qīng
ex.en: We must take into account the fact that he is young.

items.en: classifier for gifts, newspaper, magazine, paper

ex.zh: 一月通常是最冷的月份。
ex.p: yī yuè tōng cháng shì zuì lěng de yuè fèn
ex.en: January is usually the coldest month.

ex.zh: 他送给我一份漂亮的礼物。
ex.p: tā sòng gěi wǒ yī fèn piào liang de lǐ wù
ex.en: He gave a nice present to me.

ex.zh: 这些信息对我们非常重要。
ex.p: zhè xiē xìn xī duì wǒ men fēi cháng zhòng yào
ex.en: The information is very important to us.

ex.zh: 我想要了解一些信息。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào liǎo jiě yī xiē xìn xī
ex.en: I'd like some information.

ex.zh: 他们给图书馆提供了很多书。
ex.p: tā men gěi tú shū guǎn tí gōng le hěn duō shū
ex.en: They furnished the library with many books.

ex.zh: 奶牛为我们提供牛奶。
ex.p: nǎi niú wèi wǒ men tí gōng niú nǎi
ex.en: Cows provide us with milk.

ex.zh: 他来不来对我来说没区别。
ex.p: tā lái bù lái duì wǒ lái shuō méi qū bié
ex.en: It makes no difference to me whether he comes or not.

ex.zh: 你们很容易就能看出区别。
ex.p: nǐ men hěn róng yì jiù néng kàn chū qū bié
ex.en: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.

items.en: finger; to point at or to

ex.zh: 我不知道你指的是什么。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ zhǐ de shì shén me
ex.en: I don't know what you're referring to.

ex.zh: 我们试图让手指互相交错。
ex.p: wǒ men shì tú ràng shǒu zhǐ hù xiāng jiāo cuò
ex.en: We kept our fingers crossed.

ex.zh: 你知道怎么使用吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me shǐ yòng ma
ex.en: Do you know how to use this?

ex.zh: 您会使用计算机吗？
ex.p: nín huì shǐ yòng jì suàn jī ma
ex.en: Can you use a computer?

ex.zh: 我们终于达到了我们的目标。
ex.p: wǒ men zhōng yú dá dào le wǒ men de mù biāo
ex.en: At last, we reached our destination.

ex.zh: 你们的目标变了吗？
ex.p: nǐ men de mù biāo biàn le ma
ex.en: Have your goals changed?

ex.zh: 你能为我翻译这首歌吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng wèi wǒ fān yì zhè shǒu gē ma
ex.en: Can you translate this song for me?

ex.zh: 他的每首歌都长期备受欢迎。
ex.p: tā de měi shǒu gē dōu cháng qī bèi shòu huān yíng
ex.en: Every one of his songs was a hit.

ex.zh: 我们到了就打电话跟您联系。
ex.p: wǒ men dào le jiù dǎ diàn huà gēn nín lián xì
ex.en: We'll contact you by phone as soon as we arrive.

ex.zh: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。
ex.p: wǒ men lián xì shàng tā men yǐ jīng wèi shí yǐ wǎn
ex.en: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.

ex.zh: 他按照字面上的意思。
ex.p: tā àn zhào zì miàn shàng de yì si
ex.en: He took it literally.

ex.zh: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。
ex.p: lǎo shī àn zhào shēn gāo gěi hái zi men pái duì
ex.en: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.

ex.zh: 上个月我买了一台新电脑。
ex.p: shàng gè yuè wǒ mǎi le yī tái xīn diàn nǎo
ex.en: I bought a new computer last month.

ex.zh: 我前一天丢了一台相机。
ex.p: wǒ qián yī tiān diū le yī tái xiàng jī
ex.en: I had lost a camera the previous day.

ex.zh: 今天晚上我打算看电视。
ex.p: jīn tiān wǎn shang wǒ dǎ suàn kàn diàn shì
ex.en: I am going to watch TV this evening.

ex.zh: 你打算在这个国家待多久？
ex.p: nǐ dǎ suàn zài zhè gè guó jiā dài duō jiǔ
ex.en: How long do you plan to stay in this country?

items.en: to obtain; to receive; to get

ex.zh: 你在说我有生命危险吗？
ex.p: nǐ zài shuō wǒ yǒu shēng mìng wēi xiǎn ma
ex.en: Are you saying my life is in danger?

ex.zh: 水是生命所不可缺少的。
ex.p: shuǐ shì shēng mìng suǒ bù kě quē shǎo de
ex.en: Water is essential to life.

ex.zh: 你对这件事有什么看法？
ex.p: nǐ duì zhè jiàn shì yǒu shén me kàn fǎ
ex.en: What do you think of it?

ex.zh: 你能帮我把这译成法语吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè yì chéng fǎ yǔ ma
ex.en: Could you help me translate this into French?

ex.zh: 我们必须保持家庭传统。
ex.p: wǒ men bì xū bǎo chí jiā tíng chuán tǒng
ex.en: We must keep up the family traditions.

ex.zh: 这个家庭热情地接待了我。
ex.p: zhè gè jiā tíng rè qíng de jiē dài le wǒ
ex.en: This family gave me a warm welcome.

ex.zh: 一切看上去正常。
ex.p: yī qiè kàn shang qu zhèng cháng
ex.en: Everything seems OK.

sents.en: Use a dictionary to find the meanings of the phrases below.

sents.zh: 一个足球队由十一个球员组成。
sents.p: yī gè zú qiú duì yóu shí yī gè qiú yuán zǔ chéng
sents.en: A soccer team consists of eleven players.

sents.zh: 他一定没有多考虑就说了。
sents.p: tā yī dìng méi yǒu duō kǎo lǜ jiù shuō le
sents.en: He must have said so without giving it much thought.

sents.zh: 你确定他们可以干这个吗？
sents.p: nǐ què dìng tā men kě yǐ gàn zhè gè ma
sents.en: Are you sure they can do this?

sents.zh: 直接和我说我要做什么。
sents.p: zhí jiē hé wǒ shuō wǒ yào zuò shén me
sents.en: Just tell me what I have to do.

sents.zh: 如果您想知道，直接问就是了。
sents.p: rú guǒ nín xiǎng zhī dào zhí jiē wèn jiù shì le
sents.en: If you want to know, just ask.

sents.zh: 你们永远不会一个人的。
sents.p: nǐ men yǒng yuǎn bù huì yī gè rén de
sents.en: You'll never be alone.

sents.zh: 我永远不会忘记您的帮助。
sents.p: wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù huì wàng jì nín de bāng zhù
sents.en: I'll never forget how helpful you've been.

sents.zh: 他强调都市生活的便利方面。
sents.p: tā qiáng diào dū shì shēng huó de biàn lì fāng miàn
sents.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.

sents.zh: 他在这方面不是很严格。
sents.p: tā zài zhè fāng miàn bù shì hěn yán gé
sents.en: He's not very strict about this.

sents.zh: 他和他的姐妹们目前都住在东京。
sents.p: tā hé tā de jiě mèi men mù qián dōu zhù zài dōng jīng
sents.en: He and his sisters are currently living in Tokyo.

sents.zh: 目前我待在酒店。
sents.p: mù qián wǒ dài zài jiǔ diàn
sents.en: I am staying at the hotel for the time being.

sents.zh: 她仔细考虑了他的提议。
sents.p: tā zǐ xì kǎo lǜ le tā de tí yì
sents.en: She considered his offer carefully.

sents.zh: 我们必须考虑到他很年轻。
sents.p: wǒ men bì xū kǎo lǜ dào tā hěn nián qīng
sents.en: We must take into account the fact that he is young.

sents.zh: 一月通常是最冷的月份。
sents.p: yī yuè tōng cháng shì zuì lěng de yuè fèn
sents.en: January is usually the coldest month.

sents.zh: 他送给我一份漂亮的礼物。
sents.p: tā sòng gěi wǒ yī fèn piào liang de lǐ wù
sents.en: He gave a nice present to me.

sents.zh: 这些信息对我们非常重要。
sents.p: zhè xiē xìn xī duì wǒ men fēi cháng zhòng yào
sents.en: The information is very important to us.

sents.zh: 我想要了解一些信息。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào liǎo jiě yī xiē xìn xī
sents.en: I'd like some information.

sents.zh: 他们给图书馆提供了很多书。
sents.p: tā men gěi tú shū guǎn tí gōng le hěn duō shū
sents.en: They furnished the library with many books.

sents.zh: 奶牛为我们提供牛奶。
sents.p: nǎi niú wèi wǒ men tí gōng niú nǎi
sents.en: Cows provide us with milk.

sents.zh: 他来不来对我来说没区别。
sents.p: tā lái bù lái duì wǒ lái shuō méi qū bié
sents.en: It makes no difference to me whether he comes or not.

sents.zh: 你们很容易就能看出区别。
sents.p: nǐ men hěn róng yì jiù néng kàn chū qū bié
sents.en: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.

sents.zh: 我不知道你指的是什么。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ zhǐ de shì shén me
sents.en: I don't know what you're referring to.

sents.zh: 我们试图让手指互相交错。
sents.p: wǒ men shì tú ràng shǒu zhǐ hù xiāng jiāo cuò
sents.en: We kept our fingers crossed.

sents.zh: 你知道怎么使用吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào zěn me shǐ yòng ma
sents.en: Do you know how to use this?

sents.zh: 您会使用计算机吗？
sents.p: nín huì shǐ yòng jì suàn jī ma
sents.en: Can you use a computer?

sents.zh: 我们终于达到了我们的目标。
sents.p: wǒ men zhōng yú dá dào le wǒ men de mù biāo
sents.en: At last, we reached our destination.

sents.zh: 你们的目标变了吗？
sents.p: nǐ men de mù biāo biàn le ma
sents.en: Have your goals changed?

sents.zh: 你能为我翻译这首歌吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng wèi wǒ fān yì zhè shǒu gē ma
sents.en: Can you translate this song for me?

sents.zh: 他的每首歌都长期备受欢迎。
sents.p: tā de měi shǒu gē dōu cháng qī bèi shòu huān yíng
sents.en: Every one of his songs was a hit.

sents.zh: 我们到了就打电话跟您联系。
sents.p: wǒ men dào le jiù dǎ diàn huà gēn nín lián xì
sents.en: We'll contact you by phone as soon as we arrive.

sents.zh: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。
sents.p: wǒ men lián xì shàng tā men yǐ jīng wèi shí yǐ wǎn
sents.en: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.

sents.zh: 他按照字面上的意思。
sents.p: tā àn zhào zì miàn shàng de yì si
sents.en: He took it literally.

sents.zh: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。
sents.p: lǎo shī àn zhào shēn gāo gěi hái zi men pái duì
sents.en: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.

sents.zh: 上个月我买了一台新电脑。
sents.p: shàng gè yuè wǒ mǎi le yī tái xīn diàn nǎo
sents.en: I bought a new computer last month.

sents.zh: 我前一天丢了一台相机。
sents.p: wǒ qián yī tiān diū le yī tái xiàng jī
sents.en: I had lost a camera the previous day.

sents.zh: 今天晚上我打算看电视。
sents.p: jīn tiān wǎn shang wǒ dǎ suàn kàn diàn shì
sents.en: I am going to watch TV this evening.

sents.zh: 你打算在这个国家待多久？
sents.p: nǐ dǎ suàn zài zhè gè guó jiā dài duō jiǔ
sents.en: How long do you plan to stay in this country?

sents.zh: 你在说我有生命危险吗？
sents.p: nǐ zài shuō wǒ yǒu shēng mìng wēi xiǎn ma
sents.en: Are you saying my life is in danger?

sents.zh: 水是生命所不可缺少的。
sents.p: shuǐ shì shēng mìng suǒ bù kě quē shǎo de
sents.en: Water is essential to life.

sents.zh: 你对这件事有什么看法？
sents.p: nǐ duì zhè jiàn shì yǒu shén me kàn fǎ
sents.en: What do you think of it?

sents.zh: 你能帮我把这译成法语吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè yì chéng fǎ yǔ ma
sents.en: Could you help me translate this into French?

sents.zh: 我们必须保持家庭传统。
sents.p: wǒ men bì xū bǎo chí jiā tíng chuán tǒng
sents.en: We must keep up the family traditions.

sents.zh: 这个家庭热情地接待了我。
sents.p: zhè gè jiā tíng rè qíng de jiē dài le wǒ
sents.en: This family gave me a warm welcome.

sents.zh: 一切看上去正常。
sents.p: yī qiè kàn shang qu zhèng cháng
sents.en: Everything seems OK.

units.title: Relationships and emotions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

ex.zh: 今天早上我耳朵流血了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ ěr duo liú xuè le
ex.en: My ear was bleeding this morning.

ex.zh: 墙上还是有血。
ex.p: qiáng shàng hái shi yǒu xuè
ex.en: There's still blood on the wall.

items.en: to be able to; to subdue

ex.zh: 他帮助我克服了困难。
ex.p: tā bāng zhù wǒ kè fú le kùn nan
ex.en: He helped me to get over the difficulties.

ex.zh: 生活就像一盒巧克力。
ex.p: shēng huó jiù xiàng yī hé qiǎo kè lì
ex.en: Life is like a box of chocolates.

ex.zh: 你们到底对我做了什么？
ex.p: nǐ men dào dǐ duì wǒ zuò le shén me
ex.en: What have you guys done to me?

ex.zh: 你到底为什么要这么做？
ex.p: nǐ dào dǐ wèi shén me yào zhè me zuò
ex.en: Why exactly did you need to do that?

ex.zh: 我在打开包装时遇到了麻烦。
ex.p: wǒ zài dǎ kāi bāo zhuāng shí yù dào le má fan
ex.en: I had trouble unwrapping the package.

ex.zh: 他用水装满了瓶子。
ex.p: tā yòng shuǐ zhuāng mǎn le píng zi
ex.en: He filled the bottle with water.

ex.zh: 非常感谢你所做的一切。
ex.p: fēi cháng gǎn xiè nǐ suǒ zuò de yī qiè
ex.en: I'm very grateful for everything you've done for me.

ex.zh: 我十分感谢你的好意。
ex.p: wǒ shí fēn gǎn xiè nǐ de hǎo yì
ex.en: I thank you very much for your kindness.

ex.zh: 听讲座时，你应该保持安静。
ex.p: tīng jiǎng zuò shí nǐ yīng gāi bǎo chí ān jìng
ex.en: When listening to a lecture, you should be quiet.

ex.zh: 我从没有爬过这座山。
ex.p: wǒ cóng méi yǒu pá guò zhè zuò shān
ex.en: I've never climbed this mountain.

ex.zh: 他在入学考试中失败了。
ex.p: tā zài rù xué kǎo shì zhōng shī bài le
ex.en: He failed the entrance exam.

ex.zh: 他忙着准备入学考试。
ex.p: tā máng zhe zhǔn bèi rù xué kǎo shì
ex.en: He is busy preparing for the entrance examination.

ex.zh: 他失信了，这让他妻子生气。
ex.p: tā shī xìn le zhè ràng tā qī zǐ shēng qì
ex.en: He broke his word, which made his wife angry.

ex.zh: 你为什么对我这么小气？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me duì wǒ zhè me xiǎo qì
ex.en: Why are you so mean to me?

ex.zh: 事故差点让他丢了性命。
ex.p: shì gù chà diǎn ràng tā diū le xìng mìng
ex.en: The accident almost cost him his life.

ex.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。
ex.p: zhǔn què xìng zài jì suàn zhōng hěn zhòng yào
ex.en: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.

items.en: to pour out; to tip out; to dump

ex.zh: 她倒很可爱，但我不喜欢她。
ex.p: tā dào hěn kě ài dàn wǒ bù xǐ huan tā
ex.en: She may be cute, but I don't like her.

ex.zh: 她总是在班上拿倒数第一。
ex.p: tā zǒng shì zài bān shàng ná dào shǔ dì yī
ex.en: She is always at the bottom of the class.

items.en: to propose; to suggest; to recommend

ex.zh: 你一定要注意他的建议。
ex.p: nǐ yī dìng yào zhù yì tā de jiàn yì
ex.en: You must pay attention to his advice.

ex.zh: 你最好照着医生的建议做。
ex.p: nǐ zuì hǎo zhào zhe yī shēng de jiàn yì zuò
ex.en: You'd better do as the doctor advised you.

ex.zh: 这个问题有多严重？
ex.p: zhè gè wèn tí yǒu duō yán zhòng
ex.en: How serious is the problem?

ex.zh: 这是很严重的病。
ex.p: zhè shì hěn yán zhòng de bìng
ex.en: It's a very serious illness.

items.en: to make an appointment; to invite

ex.zh: 你儿子正在和我女儿约会。
ex.p: nǐ ér zi zhèng zài hé wǒ nǚ ér yuē huì
ex.en: Your son is dating my daughter.

ex.zh: 我父母不让我和男生约会。
ex.p: wǒ fù mǔ bù ràng wǒ hé nán shēng yuē huì
ex.en: My parents won't let me date.

ex.zh: 今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。
ex.p: jīn wǎn de yè kōng xīng guāng fēi cháng míng liàng
ex.en: The stars are shining very brightly in the sky tonight.

ex.zh: 我看见远处有灯光。
ex.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yuǎn chù yǒu dēng guāng
ex.en: I saw a light in the distance.

ex.zh: 法律有很多不明确的地方。
ex.p: fǎ lǜ yǒu hěn duō bù míng què de dì fāng
ex.en: The law is full of ambiguities.

ex.zh: 法律之前人人平等。
ex.p: fǎ lǜ zhī qián rén rén píng děng
ex.en: All men are equal under the law.

ex.zh: 他接手了他父亲的公司。
ex.p: tā jiē shǒu le tā fù qīn de gōng sī
ex.en: He has taken over his father's business.

ex.zh: 她父亲在她三岁时死了。
ex.p: tā fù qīn zài tā sān suì shí sǐ le
ex.en: Her father died when she was three.

ex.zh: 你的项目进展得怎么样？
ex.p: nǐ de xiàng mù jìn zhǎn de zěn me yàng
ex.en: How's your project going?

ex.zh: 他们一起为这个项目工作过。
ex.p: tā men yī qǐ wèi zhè gè xiàng mù gōng zuò guò
ex.en: They worked jointly on this project.

ex.zh: 我的预感被证明是正确的。
ex.p: wǒ de yù gǎn bèi zhèng míng shì zhèng què de
ex.en: My premonition turned out to be right.

ex.zh: 实验证明了他的理论。
ex.p: shí yàn zhèng míng le tā de lǐ lùn
ex.en: The experiment confirmed his theory.

ex.zh: 你到底在我房间里干什么？
ex.p: nǐ dào dǐ zài wǒ fáng jiān lǐ gàn shén me
ex.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?

ex.zh: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。
ex.p: tā men de hé tong zài zhè gè yuè dǐ dào qī
ex.en: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.

ex.zh: 他喜欢数学，但我不喜欢。
ex.p: tā xǐ huan shù xué dàn wǒ bù xǐ huan
ex.en: He likes math, but I don't.

ex.zh: 出国的人数一直在增加。
ex.p: chū guó de rén shù yī zhí zài zēng jiā
ex.en: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.

ex.zh: 他们像老朋友一样交谈。
ex.p: tā men xiàng lǎo péng you yī yàng jiāo tán
ex.en: They talked together like old friends.

ex.zh: 他们谈计划谈了几个小时。
ex.p: tā men tán jì huà tán le jǐ gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: They talked over the plan for hours.

ex.zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。
ex.p: tā jiě shì le jù zi de zì miàn yì si
ex.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentence.

ex.zh: 他解释事故是怎么发生的。
ex.p: tā jiě shì shì gù shì zěn me fā shēng de
ex.en: He explained how the accident came about.

ex.zh: 法语说得快，我就难以理解。
ex.p: fǎ yǔ shuō de kuài wǒ jiù nán yǐ lǐ jiě
ex.en: It's hard for me to understand French when it's spoken quickly.

ex.zh: 我不理解你的意思。
ex.p: wǒ bù lǐ jiě nǐ de yì si
ex.en: I don't get what you mean.

ex.zh: 他们并不总是服从父母。
ex.p: tā men bìng bù zǒng shì fú cóng fù mǔ
ex.en: They don't always obey their parents.

ex.zh: 他八岁时离开了他的父母。
ex.p: tā bā suì shí lí kāi le tā de fù mǔ
ex.en: He left his parents when he was eight years old.

ex.zh: 东京是一个很大的城市。
ex.p: dōng jīng shì yī gè hěn dà de chéng shì
ex.en: Tokyo is a big city.

ex.zh: 你的学校在这个城市吗？
ex.p: nǐ de xué xiào zài zhè gè chéng shì ma
ex.en: Is your school in this town?

ex.zh: 我最终得到了我要的那本书。
ex.p: wǒ zuì zhōng dé dào le wǒ yào de nà běn shū
ex.en: I finally got hold of that book I wanted.

ex.zh: 公车最终停了下来。
ex.p: gōng chē zuì zhōng tíng le xià lai
ex.en: At last, the bus stopped.

ex.zh: 你怎么敢这样跟我说话！
ex.p: nǐ zěn me gǎn zhè yàng gēn wǒ shuō huà
ex.en: How dare you speak to me like that!

ex.zh: 我不敢对他说这种话。
ex.p: wǒ bù gǎn duì tā shuō zhè zhǒng huà
ex.en: I don't dare tell him such a thing.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第49单元

Relationships and emotions

Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 今天早上我耳朵流血了。
sents.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ ěr duo liú xuè le
sents.en: My ear was bleeding this morning.

sents.zh: 墙上还是有血。
sents.p: qiáng shàng hái shi yǒu xuè
sents.en: There's still blood on the wall.

sents.zh: 他帮助我克服了困难。
sents.p: tā bāng zhù wǒ kè fú le kùn nan
sents.en: He helped me to get over the difficulties.

sents.zh: 生活就像一盒巧克力。
sents.p: shēng huó jiù xiàng yī hé qiǎo kè lì
sents.en: Life is like a box of chocolates.

sents.zh: 你们到底对我做了什么？
sents.p: nǐ men dào dǐ duì wǒ zuò le shén me
sents.en: What have you guys done to me?

sents.zh: 你到底为什么要这么做？
sents.p: nǐ dào dǐ wèi shén me yào zhè me zuò
sents.en: Why exactly did you need to do that?

sents.zh: 我在打开包装时遇到了麻烦。
sents.p: wǒ zài dǎ kāi bāo zhuāng shí yù dào le má fan
sents.en: I had trouble unwrapping the package.

sents.zh: 他用水装满了瓶子。
sents.p: tā yòng shuǐ zhuāng mǎn le píng zi
sents.en: He filled the bottle with water.

sents.zh: 非常感谢你所做的一切。
sents.p: fēi cháng gǎn xiè nǐ suǒ zuò de yī qiè
sents.en: I'm very grateful for everything you've done for me.

sents.zh: 我十分感谢你的好意。
sents.p: wǒ shí fēn gǎn xiè nǐ de hǎo yì
sents.en: I thank you very much for your kindness.

sents.zh: 听讲座时，你应该保持安静。
sents.p: tīng jiǎng zuò shí nǐ yīng gāi bǎo chí ān jìng
sents.en: When listening to a lecture, you should be quiet.

sents.zh: 我从没有爬过这座山。
sents.p: wǒ cóng méi yǒu pá guò zhè zuò shān
sents.en: I've never climbed this mountain.

sents.zh: 他在入学考试中失败了。
sents.p: tā zài rù xué kǎo shì zhōng shī bài le
sents.en: He failed the entrance exam.

sents.zh: 他忙着准备入学考试。
sents.p: tā máng zhe zhǔn bèi rù xué kǎo shì
sents.en: He is busy preparing for the entrance examination.

sents.zh: 他失信了，这让他妻子生气。
sents.p: tā shī xìn le zhè ràng tā qī zǐ shēng qì
sents.en: He broke his word, which made his wife angry.

sents.zh: 你为什么对我这么小气？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me duì wǒ zhè me xiǎo qì
sents.en: Why are you so mean to me?

sents.zh: 事故差点让他丢了性命。
sents.p: shì gù chà diǎn ràng tā diū le xìng mìng
sents.en: The accident almost cost him his life.

sents.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。
sents.p: zhǔn què xìng zài jì suàn zhōng hěn zhòng yào
sents.en: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.

sents.zh: 她倒很可爱，但我不喜欢她。
sents.p: tā dào hěn kě ài dàn wǒ bù xǐ huan tā
sents.en: She may be cute, but I don't like her.

sents.zh: 她总是在班上拿倒数第一。
sents.p: tā zǒng shì zài bān shàng ná dào shǔ dì yī
sents.en: She is always at the bottom of the class.

sents.zh: 你一定要注意他的建议。
sents.p: nǐ yī dìng yào zhù yì tā de jiàn yì
sents.en: You must pay attention to his advice.

sents.zh: 你最好照着医生的建议做。
sents.p: nǐ zuì hǎo zhào zhe yī shēng de jiàn yì zuò
sents.en: You'd better do as the doctor advised you.

sents.zh: 这个问题有多严重？
sents.p: zhè gè wèn tí yǒu duō yán zhòng
sents.en: How serious is the problem?

sents.zh: 这是很严重的病。
sents.p: zhè shì hěn yán zhòng de bìng
sents.en: It's a very serious illness.

sents.zh: 你儿子正在和我女儿约会。
sents.p: nǐ ér zi zhèng zài hé wǒ nǚ ér yuē huì
sents.en: Your son is dating my daughter.

sents.zh: 我父母不让我和男生约会。
sents.p: wǒ fù mǔ bù ràng wǒ hé nán shēng yuē huì
sents.en: My parents won't let me date.

sents.zh: 今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。
sents.p: jīn wǎn de yè kōng xīng guāng fēi cháng míng liàng
sents.en: The stars are shining very brightly in the sky tonight.

sents.zh: 我看见远处有灯光。
sents.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yuǎn chù yǒu dēng guāng
sents.en: I saw a light in the distance.

sents.zh: 法律有很多不明确的地方。
sents.p: fǎ lǜ yǒu hěn duō bù míng què de dì fāng
sents.en: The law is full of ambiguities.

sents.zh: 法律之前人人平等。
sents.p: fǎ lǜ zhī qián rén rén píng děng
sents.en: All men are equal under the law.

sents.zh: 他接手了他父亲的公司。
sents.p: tā jiē shǒu le tā fù qīn de gōng sī
sents.en: He has taken over his father's business.

sents.zh: 她父亲在她三岁时死了。
sents.p: tā fù qīn zài tā sān suì shí sǐ le
sents.en: Her father died when she was three.

sents.zh: 你的项目进展得怎么样？
sents.p: nǐ de xiàng mù jìn zhǎn de zěn me yàng
sents.en: How's your project going?

sents.zh: 他们一起为这个项目工作过。
sents.p: tā men yī qǐ wèi zhè gè xiàng mù gōng zuò guò
sents.en: They worked jointly on this project.

sents.zh: 我的预感被证明是正确的。
sents.p: wǒ de yù gǎn bèi zhèng míng shì zhèng què de
sents.en: My premonition turned out to be right.

sents.zh: 实验证明了他的理论。
sents.p: shí yàn zhèng míng le tā de lǐ lùn
sents.en: The experiment confirmed his theory.

sents.zh: 你到底在我房间里干什么？
sents.p: nǐ dào dǐ zài wǒ fáng jiān lǐ gàn shén me
sents.en: What on earth are you doing in my room?

sents.zh: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。
sents.p: tā men de hé tong zài zhè gè yuè dǐ dào qī
sents.en: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.

sents.zh: 他喜欢数学，但我不喜欢。
sents.p: tā xǐ huan shù xué dàn wǒ bù xǐ huan
sents.en: He likes math, but I don't.

sents.zh: 出国的人数一直在增加。
sents.p: chū guó de rén shù yī zhí zài zēng jiā
sents.en: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.

sents.zh: 他们像老朋友一样交谈。
sents.p: tā men xiàng lǎo péng you yī yàng jiāo tán
sents.en: They talked together like old friends.

sents.zh: 他们谈计划谈了几个小时。
sents.p: tā men tán jì huà tán le jǐ gè xiǎo shí
sents.en: They talked over the plan for hours.

sents.zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。
sents.p: tā jiě shì le jù zi de zì miàn yì si
sents.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentence.

sents.zh: 他解释事故是怎么发生的。
sents.p: tā jiě shì shì gù shì zěn me fā shēng de
sents.en: He explained how the accident came about.

sents.zh: 法语说得快，我就难以理解。
sents.p: fǎ yǔ shuō de kuài wǒ jiù nán yǐ lǐ jiě
sents.en: It's hard for me to understand French when it's spoken quickly.

sents.zh: 我不理解你的意思。
sents.p: wǒ bù lǐ jiě nǐ de yì si
sents.en: I don't get what you mean.

sents.zh: 他们并不总是服从父母。
sents.p: tā men bìng bù zǒng shì fú cóng fù mǔ
sents.en: They don't always obey their parents.

sents.zh: 他八岁时离开了他的父母。
sents.p: tā bā suì shí lí kāi le tā de fù mǔ
sents.en: He left his parents when he was eight years old.

sents.zh: 东京是一个很大的城市。
sents.p: dōng jīng shì yī gè hěn dà de chéng shì
sents.en: Tokyo is a big city.

sents.zh: 你的学校在这个城市吗？
sents.p: nǐ de xué xiào zài zhè gè chéng shì ma
sents.en: Is your school in this town?

sents.zh: 我最终得到了我要的那本书。
sents.p: wǒ zuì zhōng dé dào le wǒ yào de nà běn shū
sents.en: I finally got hold of that book I wanted.

sents.zh: 公车最终停了下来。
sents.p: gōng chē zuì zhōng tíng le xià lai
sents.en: At last, the bus stopped.

sents.zh: 你怎么敢这样跟我说话！
sents.p: nǐ zěn me gǎn zhè yàng gēn wǒ shuō huà
sents.en: How dare you speak to me like that!

sents.zh: 我不敢对他说这种话。
sents.p: wǒ bù gǎn duì tā shuō zhè zhǒng huà
sents.en: I don't dare tell him such a thing.

units.title: Relationships and emotions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

ex.zh: 请重新考虑一下。
ex.p: qǐng chóng xīn kǎo lǜ yī xià
ex.en: Please reconsider.

ex.zh: 他提议大家一起去游泳。
ex.p: tā tí yì dà jiā yī qǐ qù yóu yǒng
ex.en: He suggested that we go for a swim.

ex.zh: 你不需要提高你的音量。
ex.p: nǐ bù xū yào tí gāo nǐ de yīn liàng
ex.en: You don't have to raise your voice.

ex.zh: 他跟我讲了他的人生故事。
ex.p: tā gēn wǒ jiǎng le tā de rén shēng gù shì
ex.en: He told me his life's story.

ex.zh: 人生是不公平的，是吧？
ex.p: rén shēng shì bù gōng píng de shì ba
ex.en: Life isn't fair, is it?

ex.zh: 我完全不负任何责任。
ex.p: wǒ wán quán bù fù rèn hé zé rèn
ex.en: I don't take any responsibility at all.

ex.zh: 做那事是我的责任。
ex.p: zuò nà shì shì wǒ de zé rèn
ex.en: It was my duty to do that.

ex.zh: 我们真的感激他们的努力。
ex.p: wǒ men zhēn de gǎn jī tā men de nǔ lì
ex.en: We really appreciate their effort.

ex.zh: 我对这些故事很感兴趣。
ex.p: wǒ duì zhè xiē gù shì hěn gǎn xìng qù
ex.en: I'm very interested in these stories.

ex.zh: 我又失去了一次机会。
ex.p: wǒ yòu shī qù le yī cì jī huì
ex.en: I've missed another chance.

ex.zh: 我只是不想失去你。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ shì bù xiǎng shī qù nǐ
ex.en: I just don't want to lose you.

ex.zh: 她降低了收音机的音量。
ex.p: tā jiàng dī le shōu yīn jī de yīn liàng
ex.en: She turned down the radio.

ex.zh: 我觉得我们得调低价格。
ex.p: wǒ jué de wǒ men de diào dī jià gé
ex.en: I think we should lower the price.

ex.zh: 药物的作用还不确定。
ex.p: yào wù de zuò yòng hái bù què dìng
ex.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.

ex.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
ex.p: diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
ex.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.

ex.zh: 那条新裙子让她很满意。
ex.p: nà tiáo xīn qún zi ràng tā hěn mǎn yì
ex.en: She was pleased with the new dress.

ex.zh: 我对我的人生很满意。
ex.p: wǒ duì wǒ de rén shēng hěn mǎn yì
ex.en: I'm quite satisfied with my life.

ex.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雪。
ex.p: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān huì xià xuě
ex.en: The forecast says it'll snow tomorrow.

ex.zh: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。
ex.p: hěn nán shuō míng tiān de tiān qì jiāng huì zěn yàng
ex.en: It's hard to say what the weather will be like tomorrow.

ex.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。
ex.p: xǔ duō rén zài gōng yè chéng shì gōng zuò
ex.en: Many people work in industrial towns.

ex.zh: 许多人夏天在这里游泳。
ex.p: xǔ duō rén xià tiān zài zhè lǐ yóu yǒng
ex.en: A lot of people swim here in the summer.

ex.zh: 请给我同样的东西。
ex.p: qǐng gěi wǒ tóng yàng de dōng xi
ex.en: Give me the same, please.

ex.zh: 我很确定你也会为我做同样的事。
ex.p: wǒ hěn què dìng nǐ yě huì wèi wǒ zuò tóng yàng de shì
ex.en: I'm sure you would do the same for me.

ex.zh: 他每天都在公园中跑步。
ex.p: tā měi tiān dōu zài gōng yuán zhōng pǎo bù
ex.en: He runs in the park every day.

ex.zh: 去公园散步你觉得怎么样？
ex.p: qù gōng yuán sàn bù nǐ jué de zěn me yàng
ex.en: What do you say to taking a walk in the park?

ex.zh: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。
ex.p: shì zhe yòng jī jí de tài du qù miàn duì rèn hé shì qing
ex.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.

items.en: due to; as a result of

ex.zh: 由于我生病了，我便没去上学。
ex.p: yóu yú wǒ shēng bìng le wǒ biàn méi qù shàng xué
ex.en: Since I was sick, I didn't go to school.

ex.zh: 由于下雨，我们没能上外头打网球。
ex.p: yóu yú xià yǔ wǒ men méi néng shàng wài tou dǎ wǎng qiú
ex.en: The rain stopped us from being able to play tennis outside.

ex.zh: 孩子在母亲的怀中熟睡。
ex.p: hái zi zài mǔ qīn de huái zhōng shú shuì
ex.en: The baby was fast asleep in her mother's arms.

ex.zh: 我会给我的母亲寄封信。
ex.p: wǒ huì gěi wǒ de mǔ qīn jì fēng xìn
ex.en: I'll send my mother a letter.

ex.zh: 我们很高兴再次见到你。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng zài cì jiàn dào nǐ
ex.en: We are happy to see you again.

ex.zh: 他再次被选为市长。
ex.p: tā zài cì bèi xuǎn wèi shì zhǎng
ex.en: He was re-elected mayor.

ex.zh: 在我的部门里有七男四女。
ex.p: zài wǒ de bù mén lǐ yǒu qī nán sì nǚ
ex.en: There are seven men and four women in my section.

ex.zh: 谁负责这个部门？
ex.p: shéi fù zé zhè gè bù mén
ex.en: Who's in charge of this section?

ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，他还是出去了。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn xià zhe yù tā hái shi chū qù le
ex.en: He went out in spite of the rain.

ex.zh: 尽管天气很冷，孩子却没有大衣穿。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn tiān qì hěn lěng hái zi què méi yǒu dà yī chuān
ex.en: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.

ex.zh: 他选每个词都深思熟虑。
ex.p: tā xuǎn měi gè cí dōu shēn sī shú lǜ
ex.en: He chose every word with care.

ex.zh: 这个湖在这个地方很深。
ex.p: zhè gè hú zài zhè gè dì fāng hěn shēn
ex.en: The lake is deep here.

ex.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。
ex.p: wǒ men tán lùn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de huà tí
ex.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.

ex.zh: 他有各种各样的书。
ex.p: tā yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de shū
ex.en: He has all kinds of books.

ex.zh: 这个想法仍然在我心中。
ex.p: zhè gè xiǎng fǎ réng rán zài wǒ xīn zhōng
ex.en: The idea is still in my mind.

ex.zh: 他仍然时不时来看我。
ex.p: tā réng rán shí bù shí lái kàn wǒ
ex.en: He still comes to see me now and then.

ex.zh: 他有许多不愉快的经历。
ex.p: tā yǒu xǔ duō bù yú kuài de jīng lì
ex.en: He's had many unhappy experiences.

ex.zh: 我仍然需要一个答案。
ex.p: wǒ réng rán xū yào yī gè dá àn
ex.en: I still need an answer.

ex.zh: 我仍是这里的老板。
ex.p: wǒ réng shì zhè lǐ de lǎo bǎn
ex.en: I'm still the boss here.

ex.zh: 你今天可以休假一天。
ex.p: nǐ jīn tiān kě yǐ xiū jià yī tiān
ex.en: You can take today off.

ex.zh: 好久没有休一个真正的假期了。
ex.p: hǎo jiǔ méi yǒu xiū yī gè zhēn zhèng de jià qī le
ex.en: It's been a long time since I've had a real vacation.

items.en: to become a member; to join

ex.zh: 我们很高兴你加入了我们班。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng nǐ jiā rù le wǒ men bān
ex.en: We are glad to have you in our class.

ex.zh: 不是所有国家都加入了联合国。
ex.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu guó jiā dōu jiā rù le lián hé guó
ex.en: Not every country belongs to the U.N.

ex.zh: 他们错把他当成他的兄弟。
ex.p: tā men cuò bǎ tā dàng chéng tā de xiōng dì
ex.en: They mistook him for his brother.

ex.zh: 他有一个兄弟和两个姐妹。
ex.p: tā yǒu yī gè xiōng dì hé liǎng gè jiě mèi
ex.en: He has a brother and two sisters.

ex.zh: 我在信封上写错了地址。
ex.p: wǒ zài xìn fēng shàng xiě cuò le dì zhǐ
ex.en: I wrote the wrong address on the envelope.

ex.zh: 我不知道他的地址。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā de dì zhǐ
ex.en: I don't know his address.

ex.zh: 你必须改掉这个坏习惯。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū gǎi diào zhè gè huài xí guàn
ex.en: You must get rid of that bad habit.

ex.zh: 你的论文还需要改进。
ex.p: nǐ de lùn wén hái xū yào gǎi jìn
ex.en: Your essay still needs some improvement.

ex.zh: 比赛前我一直都很紧张。
ex.p: bǐ sài qián wǒ yī zhí dōu hěn jǐn zhāng
ex.en: I always get nervous just before a match.

ex.zh: 你看起来真的很紧张。
ex.p: nǐ kàn qǐ lai zhēn de hěn jǐn zhāng
ex.en: You look really nervous.

items.en: to add oil; to top up with gas

ex.zh: 我们在下个加油站停一下。
ex.p: wǒ men zài xià gè jiā yóu zhàn tíng yī xià
ex.en: Let's stop at the next gas station.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第50单元

Relationships and emotions

Grammar focus: 即使…也; 无论 / 不管…都; 既然

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 请重新考虑一下。
sents.p: qǐng chóng xīn kǎo lǜ yī xià
sents.en: Please reconsider.

sents.zh: 他提议大家一起去游泳。
sents.p: tā tí yì dà jiā yī qǐ qù yóu yǒng
sents.en: He suggested that we go for a swim.

sents.zh: 你不需要提高你的音量。
sents.p: nǐ bù xū yào tí gāo nǐ de yīn liàng
sents.en: You don't have to raise your voice.

sents.zh: 他跟我讲了他的人生故事。
sents.p: tā gēn wǒ jiǎng le tā de rén shēng gù shì
sents.en: He told me his life's story.

sents.zh: 人生是不公平的，是吧？
sents.p: rén shēng shì bù gōng píng de shì ba
sents.en: Life isn't fair, is it?

sents.zh: 我完全不负任何责任。
sents.p: wǒ wán quán bù fù rèn hé zé rèn
sents.en: I don't take any responsibility at all.

sents.zh: 做那事是我的责任。
sents.p: zuò nà shì shì wǒ de zé rèn
sents.en: It was my duty to do that.

sents.zh: 我们真的感激他们的努力。
sents.p: wǒ men zhēn de gǎn jī tā men de nǔ lì
sents.en: We really appreciate their effort.

sents.zh: 我对这些故事很感兴趣。
sents.p: wǒ duì zhè xiē gù shì hěn gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: I'm very interested in these stories.

sents.zh: 我又失去了一次机会。
sents.p: wǒ yòu shī qù le yī cì jī huì
sents.en: I've missed another chance.

sents.zh: 我只是不想失去你。
sents.p: wǒ zhǐ shì bù xiǎng shī qù nǐ
sents.en: I just don't want to lose you.

sents.zh: 她降低了收音机的音量。
sents.p: tā jiàng dī le shōu yīn jī de yīn liàng
sents.en: She turned down the radio.

sents.zh: 我觉得我们得调低价格。
sents.p: wǒ jué de wǒ men de diào dī jià gé
sents.en: I think we should lower the price.

sents.zh: 药物的作用还不确定。
sents.p: yào wù de zuò yòng hái bù què dìng
sents.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.

sents.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
sents.p: diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
sents.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.

sents.zh: 那条新裙子让她很满意。
sents.p: nà tiáo xīn qún zi ràng tā hěn mǎn yì
sents.en: She was pleased with the new dress.

sents.zh: 我对我的人生很满意。
sents.p: wǒ duì wǒ de rén shēng hěn mǎn yì
sents.en: I'm quite satisfied with my life.

sents.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雪。
sents.p: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān huì xià xuě
sents.en: The forecast says it'll snow tomorrow.

sents.zh: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。
sents.p: hěn nán shuō míng tiān de tiān qì jiāng huì zěn yàng
sents.en: It's hard to say what the weather will be like tomorrow.

sents.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。
sents.p: xǔ duō rén zài gōng yè chéng shì gōng zuò
sents.en: Many people work in industrial towns.

sents.zh: 许多人夏天在这里游泳。
sents.p: xǔ duō rén xià tiān zài zhè lǐ yóu yǒng
sents.en: A lot of people swim here in the summer.

sents.zh: 请给我同样的东西。
sents.p: qǐng gěi wǒ tóng yàng de dōng xi
sents.en: Give me the same, please.

sents.zh: 我很确定你也会为我做同样的事。
sents.p: wǒ hěn què dìng nǐ yě huì wèi wǒ zuò tóng yàng de shì
sents.en: I'm sure you would do the same for me.

sents.zh: 他每天都在公园中跑步。
sents.p: tā měi tiān dōu zài gōng yuán zhōng pǎo bù
sents.en: He runs in the park every day.

sents.zh: 去公园散步你觉得怎么样？
sents.p: qù gōng yuán sàn bù nǐ jué de zěn me yàng
sents.en: What do you say to taking a walk in the park?

sents.zh: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。
sents.p: shì zhe yòng jī jí de tài du qù miàn duì rèn hé shì qing
sents.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.

sents.zh: 由于我生病了，我便没去上学。
sents.p: yóu yú wǒ shēng bìng le wǒ biàn méi qù shàng xué
sents.en: Since I was sick, I didn't go to school.

sents.zh: 由于下雨，我们没能上外头打网球。
sents.p: yóu yú xià yǔ wǒ men méi néng shàng wài tou dǎ wǎng qiú
sents.en: The rain stopped us from being able to play tennis outside.

sents.zh: 孩子在母亲的怀中熟睡。
sents.p: hái zi zài mǔ qīn de huái zhōng shú shuì
sents.en: The baby was fast asleep in her mother's arms.

sents.zh: 我会给我的母亲寄封信。
sents.p: wǒ huì gěi wǒ de mǔ qīn jì fēng xìn
sents.en: I'll send my mother a letter.

sents.zh: 我们很高兴再次见到你。
sents.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng zài cì jiàn dào nǐ
sents.en: We are happy to see you again.

sents.zh: 他再次被选为市长。
sents.p: tā zài cì bèi xuǎn wèi shì zhǎng
sents.en: He was re-elected mayor.

sents.zh: 在我的部门里有七男四女。
sents.p: zài wǒ de bù mén lǐ yǒu qī nán sì nǚ
sents.en: There are seven men and four women in my section.

sents.zh: 谁负责这个部门？
sents.p: shéi fù zé zhè gè bù mén
sents.en: Who's in charge of this section?

sents.zh: 尽管下着雨，他还是出去了。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn xià zhe yù tā hái shi chū qù le
sents.en: He went out in spite of the rain.

sents.zh: 尽管天气很冷，孩子却没有大衣穿。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn tiān qì hěn lěng hái zi què méi yǒu dà yī chuān
sents.en: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.

sents.zh: 他选每个词都深思熟虑。
sents.p: tā xuǎn měi gè cí dōu shēn sī shú lǜ
sents.en: He chose every word with care.

sents.zh: 这个湖在这个地方很深。
sents.p: zhè gè hú zài zhè gè dì fāng hěn shēn
sents.en: The lake is deep here.

sents.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。
sents.p: wǒ men tán lùn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de huà tí
sents.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.

sents.zh: 他有各种各样的书。
sents.p: tā yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de shū
sents.en: He has all kinds of books.

sents.zh: 这个想法仍然在我心中。
sents.p: zhè gè xiǎng fǎ réng rán zài wǒ xīn zhōng
sents.en: The idea is still in my mind.

sents.zh: 他仍然时不时来看我。
sents.p: tā réng rán shí bù shí lái kàn wǒ
sents.en: He still comes to see me now and then.

sents.zh: 他有许多不愉快的经历。
sents.p: tā yǒu xǔ duō bù yú kuài de jīng lì
sents.en: He's had many unhappy experiences.

sents.zh: 我仍然需要一个答案。
sents.p: wǒ réng rán xū yào yī gè dá àn
sents.en: I still need an answer.

sents.zh: 我仍是这里的老板。
sents.p: wǒ réng shì zhè lǐ de lǎo bǎn
sents.en: I'm still the boss here.

sents.zh: 你今天可以休假一天。
sents.p: nǐ jīn tiān kě yǐ xiū jià yī tiān
sents.en: You can take today off.

sents.zh: 好久没有休一个真正的假期了。
sents.p: hǎo jiǔ méi yǒu xiū yī gè zhēn zhèng de jià qī le
sents.en: It's been a long time since I've had a real vacation.

sents.zh: 我们很高兴你加入了我们班。
sents.p: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng nǐ jiā rù le wǒ men bān
sents.en: We are glad to have you in our class.

sents.zh: 不是所有国家都加入了联合国。
sents.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu guó jiā dōu jiā rù le lián hé guó
sents.en: Not every country belongs to the U.N.

sents.zh: 他们错把他当成他的兄弟。
sents.p: tā men cuò bǎ tā dàng chéng tā de xiōng dì
sents.en: They mistook him for his brother.

sents.zh: 他有一个兄弟和两个姐妹。
sents.p: tā yǒu yī gè xiōng dì hé liǎng gè jiě mèi
sents.en: He has a brother and two sisters.

sents.zh: 我在信封上写错了地址。
sents.p: wǒ zài xìn fēng shàng xiě cuò le dì zhǐ
sents.en: I wrote the wrong address on the envelope.

sents.zh: 我不知道他的地址。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā de dì zhǐ
sents.en: I don't know his address.

sents.zh: 你必须改掉这个坏习惯。
sents.p: nǐ bì xū gǎi diào zhè gè huài xí guàn
sents.en: You must get rid of that bad habit.

sents.zh: 你的论文还需要改进。
sents.p: nǐ de lùn wén hái xū yào gǎi jìn
sents.en: Your essay still needs some improvement.

sents.zh: 比赛前我一直都很紧张。
sents.p: bǐ sài qián wǒ yī zhí dōu hěn jǐn zhāng
sents.en: I always get nervous just before a match.

sents.zh: 你看起来真的很紧张。
sents.p: nǐ kàn qǐ lai zhēn de hěn jǐn zhāng
sents.en: You look really nervous.

sents.zh: 我们在下个加油站停一下。
sents.p: wǒ men zài xià gè jiā yóu zhàn tíng yī xià
sents.en: Let's stop at the next gas station.

units.title: Work and careers
units.intro: Grammar focus: 对于; 通过; 按照; 由; writing a short email

items.en: to save; to economize; to be frugal

ex.zh: 我在省钱买新车。
ex.p: wǒ zài shěng qián mǎi xīn chē
ex.en: I'm saving up to buy a new car.

ex.zh: 乘巴士更省钱。
ex.p: chéng bā shì gēng shěng qián
ex.en: It is cheaper to go by bus.

ex.zh: 我们谈这事谈了一整夜。
ex.p: wǒ men tán zhè shì tán le yī zhěng yè
ex.en: We talked about it all night.

ex.zh: 我们在午夜之后起床。
ex.p: wǒ men zài wǔ yè zhī hòu qǐ chuáng
ex.en: We got up after midnight.

ex.zh: “酒水免费吗？”“仅女士而已。”
ex.p: jiǔ shuǐ miǎn fèi ma jǐn nǚ shì ér yǐ
ex.en: "Are the drinks free?" "Only for ladies."

ex.zh: 这仅是你的想像而已。
ex.p: zhè jǐn shì nǐ de xiǎng xiàng ér yǐ
ex.en: It's just your imagination.

ex.zh: 我在这里等了三十分钟。
ex.p: wǒ zài zhè lǐ děng le sān shí fēn zhōng
ex.en: I've been waiting here for thirty minutes.

ex.zh: 他英文得到了九十分。
ex.p: tā yīng wén dé dào le jiǔ shí fēn
ex.en: He got 90% in English.

items.en: to accompany; to keep sb company

ex.zh: 她母亲一直陪着她。
ex.p: tā mǔ qīn yī zhí péi zhe tā
ex.en: Her mother always accompanies her.

ex.zh: 我陪她散步。
ex.p: wǒ péi tā sàn bù
ex.en: I accompanied her on a walk.

ex.zh: 我要睡觉了，晚安。
ex.p: wǒ yào shuì jiào le wǎn ān
ex.en: I'm going to bed. Good night.

ex.zh: 我要睡了。晚安。
ex.p: wǒ yào shuì le wǎn ān
ex.en: I'm going to bed. Good night.

ex.zh: 那家公司在广告上花了很多钱。
ex.p: nà jiā gōng sī zài guǎng gào shàng huā le hěn duō qián
ex.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.

ex.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi jìn zhǐ zhēn duì ér tóng de guǎng gào
ex.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

ex.zh: 她就那件事给他提出建议。
ex.p: tā jiù nà jiàn shì gěi tā tí chū jiàn yì
ex.en: She advised him on that matter.

ex.zh: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng tí chū jiě jué wèn tí de fāng fǎ ma
ex.en: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?

ex.zh: 这正是问题的关键。
ex.p: zhè zhèng shì wèn tí de guān jiàn
ex.en: That's the point.

ex.zh: 这是一个关键点。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè guān jiàn diǎn
ex.en: This is a crucial point.

ex.zh: 我喜欢她因我的笑话而欢笑的样子。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan tā yīn wǒ de xiào hua ér huan xiào de yàng zi
ex.en: I like the way she laughs at my jokes.

ex.zh: 我知道他的样子，但不知道他的名字。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào tā de yàng zi dàn bù zhī dào tā de míng zi
ex.en: I know him by sight, but not by name.

ex.zh: 你必须做出困难的选择。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū zuò chū kùn nan de xuǎn zé
ex.en: You have a difficult choice to make.

ex.zh: 你说你有困难。我能帮忙吗？
ex.p: nǐ shuō nǐ yǒu kùn nan wǒ néng bāng máng ma
ex.en: You said you were in trouble. How can I help?

items.en: to stipulate; to specify; to prescribe; to fix (

ex.zh: 我规定自己在九点之后不看电视。
ex.p: wǒ guī dìng zì jǐ zài jiǔ diǎn zhī hòu bù kàn diàn shì
ex.en: I make it a rule not to watch television after nine o'clock.

ex.zh: 所有文章都必须在规定时间内交上来。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu wén zhāng dōu bì xū zài guī dìng shí jiān nèi jiāo shàng lái
ex.en: All essays must be handed in on time.

items.en: to arise; to come into being; to come about

ex.zh: 如果我对你产生误解，我实在抱歉。
ex.p: rú guǒ wǒ duì nǐ chǎn shēng wù jiě wǒ shí zài bào qiàn
ex.en: If I've misjudged you, I'm terribly sorry.

items.en: to go through; to know well

ex.zh: 可能是发生交通事故了吧。
ex.p: kě néng shì fā shēng jiāo tōng shì gù le ba
ex.en: There's probably been a traffic accident.

ex.zh: 我们是两个通情达理的人。
ex.p: wǒ men shì liǎng gè tōng qíng dá lǐ de rén
ex.en: We're both reasonable people.

items.en: the other person; the other side; the other part

ex.zh: 他们互相送礼物给对方。
ex.p: tā men hù xiāng sòng lǐ wù gěi duì fāng
ex.en: They give presents to one another.

ex.zh: 我对方言很感兴趣。
ex.p: wǒ duì fāng yán hěn gǎn xìng qù
ex.en: I'm very interested in dialects.

ex.zh: 他按照字面上的意思。
ex.p: tā àn zhào zì miàn shàng de yì si
ex.en: He took it literally.

ex.zh: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。
ex.p: lǎo shī àn zhào shēn gāo gěi hái zi men pái duì
ex.en: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.

ex.zh: 她的花园是一件艺术作品。
ex.p: tā de huā yuán shì yī jiàn yì shù zuò pǐn
ex.en: Her garden is a work of art.

ex.zh: 他们的婚礼将在明天举行。
ex.p: tā men de hūn lǐ jiāng zài míng tiān jǔ xíng
ex.en: Their wedding will be tomorrow.

ex.zh: 会议将在后天于东京举行。
ex.p: huì yì jiāng zài hòu tiān yú dōng jīng jǔ xíng
ex.en: The conference is to be held in Tokyo the day after tomorrow.

ex.zh: 许多工人死于饥饿。
ex.p: xǔ duō gōng rén sǐ yú jī è
ex.en: Many of the workers died of hunger.

ex.zh: 你真是个努力的工人。
ex.p: nǐ zhēn shì gè nǔ lì de gōng rén
ex.en: You're really a hard worker.

items.en: to work a temporary or casual job

ex.zh: 我明天十点起会在办公室里。
ex.p: wǒ míng tiān shí diǎn qǐ huì zài bàn gōng shì lǐ
ex.en: I'll be in my office from ten tomorrow.

ex.zh: 你几点离开办公室？
ex.p: nǐ jǐ diǎn lí kāi bàn gōng shì
ex.en: What time will you leave the office?

items.en: to go on an official or business trip

ex.zh: 我爸爸经常去美国出差。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba jīng cháng qù měi guó chū chāi
ex.en: My father often goes to America on business.

ex.zh: 你来这里出差的？
ex.p: nǐ lái zhè lǐ chū chāi de
ex.en: Are you here on business?

items.en: to invite applications for a job; to recruit

ex.zh: 我太累了，做不了功课。
ex.p: wǒ tài lěi le zuò bù liǎo gōng kè
ex.en: I'm too sleepy to do my homework.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第51单元

Work and careers

Grammar focus: 对于; 通过; 按照; 由; writing a short email

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我在省钱买新车。
sents.p: wǒ zài shěng qián mǎi xīn chē
sents.en: I'm saving up to buy a new car.

sents.zh: 乘巴士更省钱。
sents.p: chéng bā shì gēng shěng qián
sents.en: It is cheaper to go by bus.

sents.zh: 我们谈这事谈了一整夜。
sents.p: wǒ men tán zhè shì tán le yī zhěng yè
sents.en: We talked about it all night.

sents.zh: 我们在午夜之后起床。
sents.p: wǒ men zài wǔ yè zhī hòu qǐ chuáng
sents.en: We got up after midnight.

sents.zh: “酒水免费吗？”“仅女士而已。”
sents.p: jiǔ shuǐ miǎn fèi ma jǐn nǚ shì ér yǐ
sents.en: "Are the drinks free?" "Only for ladies."

sents.zh: 这仅是你的想像而已。
sents.p: zhè jǐn shì nǐ de xiǎng xiàng ér yǐ
sents.en: It's just your imagination.

sents.zh: 我在这里等了三十分钟。
sents.p: wǒ zài zhè lǐ děng le sān shí fēn zhōng
sents.en: I've been waiting here for thirty minutes.

sents.zh: 他英文得到了九十分。
sents.p: tā yīng wén dé dào le jiǔ shí fēn
sents.en: He got 90% in English.

sents.zh: 她母亲一直陪着她。
sents.p: tā mǔ qīn yī zhí péi zhe tā
sents.en: Her mother always accompanies her.

sents.zh: 我陪她散步。
sents.p: wǒ péi tā sàn bù
sents.en: I accompanied her on a walk.

sents.zh: 我要睡觉了，晚安。
sents.p: wǒ yào shuì jiào le wǎn ān
sents.en: I'm going to bed. Good night.

sents.zh: 我要睡了。晚安。
sents.p: wǒ yào shuì le wǎn ān
sents.en: I'm going to bed. Good night.

sents.zh: 那家公司在广告上花了很多钱。
sents.p: nà jiā gōng sī zài guǎng gào shàng huā le hěn duō qián
sents.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.

sents.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
sents.p: wǒ men yīng gāi jìn zhǐ zhēn duì ér tóng de guǎng gào
sents.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.

sents.zh: 她就那件事给他提出建议。
sents.p: tā jiù nà jiàn shì gěi tā tí chū jiàn yì
sents.en: She advised him on that matter.

sents.zh: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng tí chū jiě jué wèn tí de fāng fǎ ma
sents.en: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?

sents.zh: 这正是问题的关键。
sents.p: zhè zhèng shì wèn tí de guān jiàn
sents.en: That's the point.

sents.zh: 这是一个关键点。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè guān jiàn diǎn
sents.en: This is a crucial point.

sents.zh: 我喜欢她因我的笑话而欢笑的样子。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan tā yīn wǒ de xiào hua ér huan xiào de yàng zi
sents.en: I like the way she laughs at my jokes.

sents.zh: 我知道他的样子，但不知道他的名字。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào tā de yàng zi dàn bù zhī dào tā de míng zi
sents.en: I know him by sight, but not by name.

sents.zh: 你必须做出困难的选择。
sents.p: nǐ bì xū zuò chū kùn nan de xuǎn zé
sents.en: You have a difficult choice to make.

sents.zh: 你说你有困难。我能帮忙吗？
sents.p: nǐ shuō nǐ yǒu kùn nan wǒ néng bāng máng ma
sents.en: You said you were in trouble. How can I help?

sents.zh: 我规定自己在九点之后不看电视。
sents.p: wǒ guī dìng zì jǐ zài jiǔ diǎn zhī hòu bù kàn diàn shì
sents.en: I make it a rule not to watch television after nine o'clock.

sents.zh: 所有文章都必须在规定时间内交上来。
sents.p: suǒ yǒu wén zhāng dōu bì xū zài guī dìng shí jiān nèi jiāo shàng lái
sents.en: All essays must be handed in on time.

sents.zh: 如果我对你产生误解，我实在抱歉。
sents.p: rú guǒ wǒ duì nǐ chǎn shēng wù jiě wǒ shí zài bào qiàn
sents.en: If I've misjudged you, I'm terribly sorry.

sents.zh: 可能是发生交通事故了吧。
sents.p: kě néng shì fā shēng jiāo tōng shì gù le ba
sents.en: There's probably been a traffic accident.

sents.zh: 我们是两个通情达理的人。
sents.p: wǒ men shì liǎng gè tōng qíng dá lǐ de rén
sents.en: We're both reasonable people.

sents.zh: 他们互相送礼物给对方。
sents.p: tā men hù xiāng sòng lǐ wù gěi duì fāng
sents.en: They give presents to one another.

sents.zh: 我对方言很感兴趣。
sents.p: wǒ duì fāng yán hěn gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: I'm very interested in dialects.

sents.zh: 他按照字面上的意思。
sents.p: tā àn zhào zì miàn shàng de yì si
sents.en: He took it literally.

sents.zh: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。
sents.p: lǎo shī àn zhào shēn gāo gěi hái zi men pái duì
sents.en: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.

sents.zh: 她的花园是一件艺术作品。
sents.p: tā de huā yuán shì yī jiàn yì shù zuò pǐn
sents.en: Her garden is a work of art.

sents.zh: 他们的婚礼将在明天举行。
sents.p: tā men de hūn lǐ jiāng zài míng tiān jǔ xíng
sents.en: Their wedding will be tomorrow.

sents.zh: 会议将在后天于东京举行。
sents.p: huì yì jiāng zài hòu tiān yú dōng jīng jǔ xíng
sents.en: The conference is to be held in Tokyo the day after tomorrow.

sents.zh: 许多工人死于饥饿。
sents.p: xǔ duō gōng rén sǐ yú jī è
sents.en: Many of the workers died of hunger.

sents.zh: 你真是个努力的工人。
sents.p: nǐ zhēn shì gè nǔ lì de gōng rén
sents.en: You're really a hard worker.

sents.zh: 我明天十点起会在办公室里。
sents.p: wǒ míng tiān shí diǎn qǐ huì zài bàn gōng shì lǐ
sents.en: I'll be in my office from ten tomorrow.

sents.zh: 你几点离开办公室？
sents.p: nǐ jǐ diǎn lí kāi bàn gōng shì
sents.en: What time will you leave the office?

sents.zh: 我爸爸经常去美国出差。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba jīng cháng qù měi guó chū chāi
sents.en: My father often goes to America on business.

sents.zh: 你来这里出差的？
sents.p: nǐ lái zhè lǐ chū chāi de
sents.en: Are you here on business?

sents.zh: 我太累了，做不了功课。
sents.p: wǒ tài lěi le zuò bù liǎo gōng kè
sents.en: I'm too sleepy to do my homework.

units.title: Work and careers
units.intro: Grammar focus: 对于; 通过; 按照; 由; writing a short email

ex.zh: 他放火烧了自己的房子。
ex.p: tā fàng huǒ shāo le zì jǐ de fáng zi
ex.en: He set fire to his own house.

ex.zh: 你们知道谁发明了火药吗？
ex.p: nǐ men zhī dào shéi fā míng le huǒ yào ma
ex.en: Do you know who invented gunpowder?

ex.zh: 我们本该更加努力学习。
ex.p: wǒ men běn gāi gèng jiā nǔ lì xué xí
ex.en: We should've studied harder.

ex.zh: 我们很快就可以安排您入座。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn kuài jiù kě yǐ ān pái nín rù zuò
ex.en: We can seat you soon.

ex.zh: 您的牛排要几分熟？
ex.p: nín de niú pái yào jǐ fēn shú
ex.en: How would you like your steak?

ex.zh: 日本米市场禁止进口。
ex.p: rì běn mǐ shì chǎng jìn zhǐ jìn kǒu
ex.en: Japan's rice market is closed to imports.

items.en: to leave behind; to stay behind

ex.zh: 我的银行账户里没留下钱。
ex.p: wǒ de yín háng zhàng hù lǐ méi liú xià qián
ex.en: There's no money left in my bank account.

ex.zh: 留下来和我们一起喝酒吧。
ex.p: liú xià lái hé wǒ men yī qǐ hē jiǔ bā
ex.en: Stay and have a drink with us.

ex.zh: 他强调了教育的重要性。
ex.p: tā qiáng diào le jiào yù de zhòng yào xìng
ex.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.

ex.zh: 教育的最终目的是什么？
ex.p: jiào yù de zuì zhōng mù dì shì shén me
ex.en: What is the ultimate purpose of education?

ex.zh: 明天是个大日子。
ex.p: míng tiān shì gè dà rì zi
ex.en: Tomorrow's going to be a big day.

ex.zh: 我们所有人都祝福你。
ex.p: wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu zhù fú nǐ
ex.en: Best wishes from all of us.

ex.zh: 我祝你生日快乐。
ex.p: wǒ zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè
ex.en: I wish you a happy birthday.

ex.zh: 如果你弄乱了，你来打扫。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ nòng luàn le nǐ lái dǎ sǎo
ex.en: If you make a mess, clean it up.

ex.zh: 我弟弟的房间总是很乱。
ex.p: wǒ dì di de fáng jiān zǒng shì hěn luàn
ex.en: My brother's room is always a mess.

ex.zh: 你认为他适合这个职位吗？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi tā shì hé zhè gè zhí wèi ma
ex.en: Do you think he is good for the position?

ex.zh: 大房子不一定适合住。
ex.p: dà fáng zi bù yī dìng shì hé zhù
ex.en: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.

ex.zh: 你没必要那么正式。
ex.p: nǐ méi bì yào nà me zhèng shì
ex.en: You don't have to be so formal.

ex.zh: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。
ex.p: nín méi bì yào zhǔn bèi yī gè zhèng shì de yǎn jiǎng
ex.en: You don't need to prepare a formal speech.

items.en: to give rise to; to lead to; to cause; to arouse

ex.zh: 公共汽车上发生什么了？
ex.p: gōng gòng qì chē shàng fā shēng shén me le
ex.en: What happened on the bus?

ex.zh: 公共汽车多久发车一次？
ex.p: gōng gòng qì chē duō jiǔ fā chē yī cì
ex.en: How often does the bus run?

ex.zh: 他的爱好是画有花的图。
ex.p: tā de ài hào shì huà yǒu huā de tú
ex.en: His hobby is painting pictures of flowers.

ex.zh: 她试图说服他来参加会议。
ex.p: tā shì tú shuō fú tā lái cān jiā huì yì
ex.en: She tried to persuade him to attend the meeting.

ex.zh: 你实际上想说什么？
ex.p: nǐ shí jì shàng xiǎng shuō shén me
ex.en: What do you really want to say?

ex.zh: 实际上，我非常无聊。
ex.p: shí jì shàng wǒ fēi cháng wú liáo
ex.en: Actually, it was pretty boring.

items.en: to reach; to achieve; to attain

ex.zh: 她达到了目标。
ex.p: tā dá dào le mù biāo
ex.en: She has achieved her goals.

ex.zh: 价格已经达到了十三年以来的最高点。
ex.p: jià gé yǐ jīng dá dào le shí sān nián yǐ lái de zuì gāo diǎn
ex.en: Prices have reached a 13-year high.

ex.zh: 他本应该成为一个律师。
ex.p: tā běn yīng gāi chéng wéi yī gè lǜ shī
ex.en: He should have been a lawyer.

ex.zh: 他儿子想当律师。
ex.p: tā ér zi xiǎng dāng lǜ shī
ex.en: His son wants to be a lawyer.

ex.zh: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。
ex.p: zhè zhǒng yào huì jiǎn qīng nǐ de téng tòng
ex.en: This medicine will decrease your pain.

ex.zh: 你现在感到痛苦吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiàn zài gǎn dào tòng kǔ ma
ex.en: Are you in pain now?

ex.zh: 观众深受感动。
ex.p: guān zhòng shēn shòu gǎn dòng
ex.en: The audience was deeply affected.

ex.zh: 他来这里的目的是什么？
ex.p: tā lái zhè lǐ de mù dì shì shén me
ex.en: For what purpose did he come here?

ex.zh: 这是我的目的。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ de mù dì
ex.en: That's my aim.

ex.zh: 英语成为了一门国际语言。
ex.p: yīng yǔ chéng wéi le yī mén guó jì yǔ yán
ex.en: English has become an international language.

ex.zh: 开什么国际玩笑。
ex.p: kāi shén me guó jì wán xiào
ex.en: Don't make stupid jokes.

ex.zh: 你推荐我买哪个？
ex.p: nǐ tuī jiàn wǒ mǎi nǎ gè
ex.en: Which one would you recommend I buy?

ex.zh: 她把他推出窗户。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā tuī chū chuāng hu
ex.en: She pushed him out the window.

ex.zh: 我不明白他的感受。
ex.p: wǒ bù míng bai tā de gǎn shòu
ex.en: I can't understand his feelings.

ex.zh: 没人体会我的感受。
ex.p: méi rén tǐ huì wǒ de gǎn shòu
ex.en: Nobody knows how I feel.

ex.zh: 小孩常常对科学很有热情。
ex.p: xiǎo hái cháng cháng duì kē xué hěn yǒu rè qíng
ex.en: Young children are often fascinated by science.

ex.zh: 我在学习计算机科学。
ex.p: wǒ zài xué xí jì suàn jī kē xué
ex.en: I'm studying computer science.

ex.zh: 他心情好就去散步。
ex.p: tā xīn qíng hǎo jiù qù sàn bù
ex.en: When he feels fine, he goes for a walk.

ex.zh: 我今天的心情不好。
ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān de xīn qíng bù hǎo
ex.en: I'm feeling blue today.

ex.zh: 我一整天都在看这本小说。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhěng tiān dōu zài kàn zhè běn xiǎo shuō
ex.en: I spent the whole day reading that novel.

ex.zh: 整周我们都会待在那里。
ex.p: zhěng zhōu wǒ men dū huì dài zài nà li
ex.en: We're going to stay there all week.

ex.zh: 教英语是他的职业。
ex.p: jiāo yīng yǔ shì tā de zhí yè
ex.en: Teaching English is his profession.

ex.zh: 他的职业是医生。
ex.p: tā de zhí yè shì yī shēng
ex.en: He's a doctor by profession.

ex.zh: 那是场精彩的会议。
ex.p: nà shì chǎng jīng cǎi de huì yì
ex.en: That was an excellent meeting.

sents.en: What is the ultimate purpose of education?

sents.zh: 明天是个大日子。
sents.p: míng tiān shì gè dà rì zi
sents.en: Tomorrow's going to be a big day.

sents.zh: 我们所有人都祝福你。
sents.p: wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu zhù fú nǐ
sents.en: Best wishes from all of us.

sents.zh: 我祝你生日快乐。
sents.p: wǒ zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè
sents.en: I wish you a happy birthday.

sents.zh: 如果你弄乱了，你来打扫。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ nòng luàn le nǐ lái dǎ sǎo
sents.en: If you make a mess, clean it up.

sents.zh: 我弟弟的房间总是很乱。
sents.p: wǒ dì di de fáng jiān zǒng shì hěn luàn
sents.en: My brother's room is always a mess.

sents.zh: 你认为他适合这个职位吗？
sents.p: nǐ rèn wéi tā shì hé zhè gè zhí wèi ma
sents.en: Do you think he is good for the position?

sents.zh: 大房子不一定适合住。
sents.p: dà fáng zi bù yī dìng shì hé zhù
sents.en: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.

sents.zh: 你没必要那么正式。
sents.p: nǐ méi bì yào nà me zhèng shì
sents.en: You don't have to be so formal.

sents.zh: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。
sents.p: nín méi bì yào zhǔn bèi yī gè zhèng shì de yǎn jiǎng
sents.en: You don't need to prepare a formal speech.

sents.zh: 公共汽车上发生什么了？
sents.p: gōng gòng qì chē shàng fā shēng shén me le
sents.en: What happened on the bus?

sents.zh: 公共汽车多久发车一次？
sents.p: gōng gòng qì chē duō jiǔ fā chē yī cì
sents.en: How often does the bus run?

sents.zh: 他的爱好是画有花的图。
sents.p: tā de ài hào shì huà yǒu huā de tú
sents.en: His hobby is painting pictures of flowers.

sents.zh: 她试图说服他来参加会议。
sents.p: tā shì tú shuō fú tā lái cān jiā huì yì
sents.en: She tried to persuade him to attend the meeting.

sents.zh: 你实际上想说什么？
sents.p: nǐ shí jì shàng xiǎng shuō shén me
sents.en: What do you really want to say?

sents.zh: 实际上，我非常无聊。
sents.p: shí jì shàng wǒ fēi cháng wú liáo
sents.en: Actually, it was pretty boring.

sents.zh: 她达到了目标。
sents.p: tā dá dào le mù biāo
sents.en: She has achieved her goals.

sents.zh: 价格已经达到了十三年以来的最高点。
sents.p: jià gé yǐ jīng dá dào le shí sān nián yǐ lái de zuì gāo diǎn
sents.en: Prices have reached a 13-year high.

sents.zh: 他本应该成为一个律师。
sents.p: tā běn yīng gāi chéng wéi yī gè lǜ shī
sents.en: He should have been a lawyer.

sents.zh: 他儿子想当律师。
sents.p: tā ér zi xiǎng dāng lǜ shī
sents.en: His son wants to be a lawyer.

sents.zh: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。
sents.p: zhè zhǒng yào huì jiǎn qīng nǐ de téng tòng
sents.en: This medicine will decrease your pain.

sents.zh: 你现在感到痛苦吗？
sents.p: nǐ xiàn zài gǎn dào tòng kǔ ma
sents.en: Are you in pain now?

sents.zh: 观众深受感动。
sents.p: guān zhòng shēn shòu gǎn dòng
sents.en: The audience was deeply affected.

sents.zh: 他来这里的目的是什么？
sents.p: tā lái zhè lǐ de mù dì shì shén me
sents.en: For what purpose did he come here?

sents.zh: 这是我的目的。
sents.p: zhè shì wǒ de mù dì
sents.en: That's my aim.

sents.zh: 英语成为了一门国际语言。
sents.p: yīng yǔ chéng wéi le yī mén guó jì yǔ yán
sents.en: English has become an international language.

sents.zh: 开什么国际玩笑。
sents.p: kāi shén me guó jì wán xiào
sents.en: Don't make stupid jokes.

sents.zh: 你推荐我买哪个？
sents.p: nǐ tuī jiàn wǒ mǎi nǎ gè
sents.en: Which one would you recommend I buy?

sents.zh: 她把他推出窗户。
sents.p: tā bǎ tā tuī chū chuāng hu
sents.en: She pushed him out the window.

sents.zh: 我不明白他的感受。
sents.p: wǒ bù míng bai tā de gǎn shòu
sents.en: I can't understand his feelings.

sents.zh: 没人体会我的感受。
sents.p: méi rén tǐ huì wǒ de gǎn shòu
sents.en: Nobody knows how I feel.

sents.zh: 小孩常常对科学很有热情。
sents.p: xiǎo hái cháng cháng duì kē xué hěn yǒu rè qíng
sents.en: Young children are often fascinated by science.

sents.zh: 我在学习计算机科学。
sents.p: wǒ zài xué xí jì suàn jī kē xué
sents.en: I'm studying computer science.

sents.zh: 他心情好就去散步。
sents.p: tā xīn qíng hǎo jiù qù sàn bù
sents.en: When he feels fine, he goes for a walk.

sents.zh: 我今天的心情不好。
sents.p: wǒ jīn tiān de xīn qíng bù hǎo
sents.en: I'm feeling blue today.

sents.zh: 我一整天都在看这本小说。
sents.p: wǒ yī zhěng tiān dōu zài kàn zhè běn xiǎo shuō
sents.en: I spent the whole day reading that novel.

sents.zh: 整周我们都会待在那里。
sents.p: zhěng zhōu wǒ men dū huì dài zài nà li
sents.en: We're going to stay there all week.

sents.zh: 教英语是他的职业。
sents.p: jiāo yīng yǔ shì tā de zhí yè
sents.en: Teaching English is his profession.

sents.zh: 他的职业是医生。
sents.p: tā de zhí yè shì yī shēng
sents.en: He's a doctor by profession.

sents.zh: 那是场精彩的会议。
sents.p: nà shì chǎng jīng cǎi de huì yì
sents.en: That was an excellent meeting.
