ex.zh: 如果值得一做，就值得做好。
ex.p: rú guǒ zhí de yī zuò jiù zhí de zuò hǎo
ex.en: If it is worth doing at all, it is worth doing well.

ex.zh: 这本书值得再看一遍。
ex.p: zhè běn shū zhí de zài kàn yī biàn
ex.en: This book is worth reading again.

ex.zh: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。
ex.p: xiàn zài nǚ shēng chuān niú zǎi kù hěn liú xíng
ex.en: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.

ex.zh: 网球在学生中非常流行。
ex.p: wǎng qiú zài xué sheng zhōng fēi cháng liú xíng
ex.en: Tennis is very popular among students.

ex.zh: 我确实在这里丢了东西。
ex.p: wǒ què shí zài zhè lǐ diū le dōng xi
ex.en: I'm clearly missing something here.

ex.zh: 这件事我实在不懂。
ex.p: zhè jiàn shì wǒ shí zài bù dǒng
ex.en: I simply don't understand this.

ex.zh: 他去和他的表弟待在一起了。
ex.p: tā qù hé tā de biǎo dì dài zài yī qǐ le
ex.en: He went to stay with his cousin.

ex.zh: 我将给儿子买块手表。
ex.p: wǒ jiāng gěi ér zi mǎi kuài shǒu biǎo
ex.en: I'll buy a watch for my son.

ex.zh: 顺便问一句，你今晚有空吗？
ex.p: shùn biàn wèn yī jù nǐ jīn wǎn yǒu kōng ma
ex.en: By the way, are you free tonight?

ex.zh: 你们今天下午有空吗？
ex.p: nǐ men jīn tiān xià wǔ yǒu kōng ma
ex.en: Are you free this afternoon?

ex.zh: 我正在大学里读经济。
ex.p: wǒ zhèng zài dà xué lǐ dú jīng jì
ex.en: I'm studying economics in college.

ex.zh: 你是位了不起的女性。
ex.p: nǐ shì wèi liǎo bù qǐ de nǚ xìng
ex.en: You're a wonderful woman.

ex.zh: 参与者大部分是女性。
ex.p: cān yù zhě dà bù fen shì nǚ xìng
ex.en: The participants were for the most part women.

ex.zh: 这张票三日有效。
ex.p: zhè zhāng piào sān rì yǒu xiào
ex.en: The ticket is good for three days.

ex.zh: “来杯茶吗？”“嗯，好的。”
ex.p: lái bēi chá ma èn hǎo de
ex.en: "Would you like some tea?" "Yes, please."

ex.zh: 他讨厌打扫自己的房间。
ex.p: tā tǎo yàn dǎ sǎo zì jǐ de fáng jiān
ex.en: He hates cleaning his room.

ex.zh: 我讨厌别人让我等很久。
ex.p: wǒ tǎo yàn bié ren ràng wǒ děng hěn jiǔ
ex.en: I hate when other people make me wait a long time.

items.en: to lose; to be beaten; to transport

ex.zh: 我们将会输了吗？
ex.p: wǒ men jiāng huì shū le ma
ex.en: Are we going to lose?

ex.zh: 我们比赛输了。
ex.p: wǒ men bǐ sài shū le
ex.en: We lost the game.

ex.zh: 世上没有免费的午餐。
ex.p: shì shàng méi yǒu miǎn fèi de wǔ cān
ex.en: There's no such thing as a free lunch.

ex.zh: 天下没有免费的午餐。
ex.p: tiān xià méi yǒu miǎn fèi de wǔ cān
ex.en: There's no such thing as a free lunch.

ex.zh: “我想打牌。”“我也是。”
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng dǎ pái wǒ yě shì
ex.en: "I feel like playing cards." "So do I."

ex.zh: 打牌很有意思。
ex.p: dǎ pái hěn yǒu yì si
ex.en: Playing cards is very interesting.

items.en: movement; motion; action; to act; to move

ex.zh: 这种茶对我而言不够甜。
ex.p: zhè zhǒng chá duì wǒ ér yán bù gòu tián
ex.en: This tea isn't sweet enough for me.

ex.zh: 我的法语说得不够好。
ex.p: wǒ de fǎ yǔ shuō de bù gòu hǎo
ex.en: My French isn't good enough.

ex.zh: 他们俩都在房间里。
ex.p: tā men liǎ dōu zài fáng jiān lǐ
ex.en: They are both in the room.

ex.zh: 我的想法和你的不一样。
ex.p: wǒ de xiǎng fǎ hé nǐ de bù yī yàng
ex.en: My opinion differs from yours.

ex.zh: 他们的想法太过时了。
ex.p: tā men de xiǎng fǎ tài guò shí le
ex.en: Their way of thinking is behind the times.

ex.zh: 他成为了著名的歌手。
ex.p: tā chéng wéi le zhù míng de gē shǒu
ex.en: He became a famous singer.

ex.zh: 她是一个著名的歌手。
ex.p: tā shì yī gè zhù míng de gē shǒu
ex.en: She is a famous singer.

items.en: to refuse; to decline; to reject

ex.zh: 医生们拒绝做第二次手术。
ex.p: yī shēng men jù jué zuò dì èr cì shǒu shù
ex.en: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.

ex.zh: 她的建议好像被拒绝了。
ex.p: tā de jiàn yì hǎo xiàng bèi jù jué le
ex.en: Her suggestion seems to have been turned down.

ex.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。
ex.p: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì chéng wéi yī míng fēi xíng yuán
ex.en: My dream is to become a pilot.

ex.zh: 我的梦想是成为医生。
ex.p: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì chéng wéi yī shēng
ex.en: My dream is to be a doctor.

ex.zh: 我们老师不仅说英语，还说法语。
ex.p: wǒ men lǎo shī bù jǐn shuō yīng yǔ hái shuō fa yǔ
ex.en: Our teacher doesn't just speak English, but French too.

ex.zh: 他不仅给了我们衣服，还有一点钱。
ex.p: tā bù jǐn gěi le wǒ men yī fu hái yǒu yī diǎn qián
ex.en: He gave us not only clothes but some money.

ex.zh: 我建议我们星期五出去玩。
ex.p: wǒ jiàn yì wǒ men xīng qī wǔ chū qù wán
ex.en: I suggest we go out on Friday.

ex.zh: 我星期天经常去市中心。
ex.p: wǒ xīng qī tiān jīng cháng qù shì zhōng xīn
ex.en: I often go downtown on Sunday.

ex.zh: 在面包房工作的姑娘很可爱。
ex.p: zài miàn bāo fáng gōng zuò de gū niang hěn kě ài
ex.en: The girl who works at the bakery is cute.

ex.zh: 一切进展顺利。
ex.p: yī qiè jìn zhǎn shùn lì
ex.en: Everything went smoothly.

ex.zh: 一切都很顺利。
ex.p: yī qiè dōu hěn shùn lì
ex.en: Everything went well.

ex.zh: 不是所有人都能当艺术家的。
ex.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu rén dōu néng dāng yì shù jiā de
ex.en: Not everybody can be an artist.

ex.zh: 不是每个人都想成为艺术家。
ex.p: bù shì měi gè rén dōu xiǎng chéng wéi yì shù jiā
ex.en: Not everybody wants to be an artist.

ex.zh: 真是美好的一天。
ex.p: zhēn shì měi hǎo de yī tiān
ex.en: This is a great day.

ex.zh: 那是我一生中最美好的时光之一。
ex.p: nà shì wǒ yī shēng zhōng zuì měi hǎo de shí guāng zhī yī
ex.en: That was one of the best times of my life.

sents.p: zhè zhǒng chá duì wǒ ér yán bù gòu tián
sents.en: This tea isn't sweet enough for me.

sents.zh: 我的法语说得不够好。
sents.p: wǒ de fǎ yǔ shuō de bù gòu hǎo
sents.en: My French isn't good enough.

sents.zh: 他们俩都在房间里。
sents.p: tā men liǎ dōu zài fáng jiān lǐ
sents.en: They are both in the room.

sents.zh: 我的想法和你的不一样。
sents.p: wǒ de xiǎng fǎ hé nǐ de bù yī yàng
sents.en: My opinion differs from yours.

sents.zh: 他们的想法太过时了。
sents.p: tā men de xiǎng fǎ tài guò shí le
sents.en: Their way of thinking is behind the times.

sents.zh: 他成为了著名的歌手。
sents.p: tā chéng wéi le zhù míng de gē shǒu
sents.en: He became a famous singer.

sents.zh: 她是一个著名的歌手。
sents.p: tā shì yī gè zhù míng de gē shǒu
sents.en: She is a famous singer.

sents.zh: 医生们拒绝做第二次手术。
sents.p: yī shēng men jù jué zuò dì èr cì shǒu shù
sents.en: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.

sents.zh: 她的建议好像被拒绝了。
sents.p: tā de jiàn yì hǎo xiàng bèi jù jué le
sents.en: Her suggestion seems to have been turned down.

sents.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。
sents.p: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì chéng wéi yī míng fēi xíng yuán
sents.en: My dream is to become a pilot.

sents.zh: 我的梦想是成为医生。
sents.p: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì chéng wéi yī shēng
sents.en: My dream is to be a doctor.

sents.zh: 我们老师不仅说英语，还说法语。
sents.p: wǒ men lǎo shī bù jǐn shuō yīng yǔ hái shuō fa yǔ
sents.en: Our teacher doesn't just speak English, but French too.

sents.zh: 他不仅给了我们衣服，还有一点钱。
sents.p: tā bù jǐn gěi le wǒ men yī fu hái yǒu yī diǎn qián
sents.en: He gave us not only clothes but some money.

sents.zh: 我建议我们星期五出去玩。
sents.p: wǒ jiàn yì wǒ men xīng qī wǔ chū qù wán
sents.en: I suggest we go out on Friday.

sents.zh: 我星期天经常去市中心。
sents.p: wǒ xīng qī tiān jīng cháng qù shì zhōng xīn
sents.en: I often go downtown on Sunday.

sents.zh: 在面包房工作的姑娘很可爱。
sents.p: zài miàn bāo fáng gōng zuò de gū niang hěn kě ài
sents.en: The girl who works at the bakery is cute.

sents.zh: 一切进展顺利。
sents.p: yī qiè jìn zhǎn shùn lì
sents.en: Everything went smoothly.

sents.zh: 一切都很顺利。
sents.p: yī qiè dōu hěn shùn lì
sents.en: Everything went well.

sents.zh: 不是所有人都能当艺术家的。
sents.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu rén dōu néng dāng yì shù jiā de
sents.en: Not everybody can be an artist.

sents.zh: 不是每个人都想成为艺术家。
sents.p: bù shì měi gè rén dōu xiǎng chéng wéi yì shù jiā
sents.en: Not everybody wants to be an artist.

sents.zh: 真是美好的一天。
sents.p: zhēn shì měi hǎo de yī tiān
sents.en: This is a great day.

sents.zh: 那是我一生中最美好的时光之一。
sents.p: nà shì wǒ yī shēng zhōng zuì měi hǎo de shí guāng zhī yī
sents.en: That was one of the best times of my life.

ex.zh: 她穿得像个演员。
ex.p: tā chuān de xiàng gè yǎn yuán

ex.zh: 我不喜欢她说话的态度。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan tā shuō huà de tài du
ex.en: I don't like the way she speaks.

ex.zh: 我对他的态度变了。
ex.p: wǒ duì tā de tài du biàn le
ex.en: My attitude towards him changed.

ex.zh: 这幅画被估价数百万元。
ex.p: zhè fú huà bèi gū jià shù bǎi wàn yuán
ex.en: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.

ex.zh: 把那幅画挂到墙上。
ex.p: bǎ nà fú huà guà dào qiáng shàng
ex.en: Hang that picture on the wall.

ex.zh: 我的血压很低。
ex.p: wǒ de xuè yā hěn dī
ex.en: My blood pressure is low.

ex.zh: 我有高血压。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu gāo xuè yā
ex.en: I have high blood pressure.

ex.zh: 我们昨天发出了邀请。
ex.p: wǒ men zuó tiān fā chū le yāo qǐng
ex.en: We sent out the invitations yesterday.

ex.zh: 除了我，每个人都受到了邀请。
ex.p: chú le wǒ měi gè rén dōu shòu dào le yāo qǐng
ex.en: Everyone except me was invited.

ex.zh: 你是个优秀的记者。
ex.p: nǐ shì gè yōu xiù de jì zhě
ex.en: You're an excellent journalist.

ex.zh: 她没有比她妈妈更漂亮。
ex.p: tā méi yǒu bǐ tā mā ma gēng piào liang
ex.en: She's not prettier than her mother.

ex.zh: 我妈年轻的时候非常漂亮。
ex.p: wǒ mā nián qīng de shí hou fēi cháng piào liang
ex.en: When my mother was young, she was very beautiful.

items.en: whether or not; can it or can't it

ex.zh: 能否请您给我看一下您的护照？
ex.p: néng fǒu qǐng nín gěi wǒ kàn yī xià nín de hù zhào

ex.p: tā chuān guò gōng lù

ex.p: nǐ huí lai de shí hou wǒ men zài shuō
ex.en: We can talk when you get back.

ex.p: gāng cái de huà nǐ kě yǐ zài shuō yī biàn ma
ex.en: Can you repeat what you said?

ex.zh: 那不是我故意的。
ex.p: nà bù shì wǒ gù yì de
ex.en: That wasn't my intention.

ex.zh: 那花闻起来很香。
ex.p: nà huā wén qǐ lai hěn xiāng
ex.en: That flower smells sweet.

ex.zh: 我听传闻说的。
ex.p: wǒ tīng chuán wén shuō de
ex.en: A little bird told me.

ex.zh: 他被视为村里最好的医生。
ex.p: tā bèi shì wéi cūn lǐ zuì hǎo de yī shēng

ex.p: tā yǒu tā de quē diǎn dàn shì wǒ ài tā
ex.en: I love him despite his faults.

ex.zh: 我们国家不缺石油。
ex.p: wǒ men guó jiā bù quē shí yóu
ex.en: We are not short of oil in this country.

ex.zh: 大家辛苦了！
ex.p: dà jiā xīn kǔ le
ex.en: Good job, everyone!

ex.zh: 他们工作的很辛苦。
ex.p: tā men gōng zuò de hěn xīn kǔ
ex.en: They work really hard.

ex.zh: 正好那个时候，公交车停下来了。
ex.p: zhèng hǎo nà gè shí hou gōng jiāo chē tíng xià lái le

ex.zh: 我很抱歉回复晚了。
ex.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn huí fù wǎn le
ex.en: I'm sorry for the late response.

ex.zh: 我一直都相信你的判断。
ex.p: wǒ yī zhí dōu xiāng xìn nǐ de pàn duàn

ex.p: wǒ wú fǎ pàn duàn tā de huà shì zhēn shì jià

ex.p: nǐ gěi tā men de qián huì yòng dào hǎo chu

ex.p: tā kàn shang qu hěn shāng xīn

ex.zh: 这个消息让她很伤心。
ex.p: zhè gè xiāo xi ràng tā hěn shāng xīn

ex.p: zài zhè lǐ shāo wēi xiū xi yī xià ba
ex.en: Let's rest here.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第58单元

Services: bank, hospital, renting

Grammar focus: 竟然; 难道…吗; 尽管

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 能否请您给我看一下您的护照？
sents.p: néng fǒu qǐng nín gěi wǒ kàn yī xià nín de hù zhào
sents.en: Will you show me your passport, please?

sents.zh: 我的视力正慢慢下降。
sents.p: wǒ de shì lì zhèng màn màn xià jiàng
sents.en: My eyesight is getting worse.

sents.zh: 气温突然下降了。
sents.p: qì wēn tū rán xià jiàng le
sents.en: The temperature has suddenly dropped.

sents.zh: 为什么你买了旅行保险？
sents.p: wèi shén me nǐ mǎi le lǚ xíng bǎo xiǎn
sents.en: Why did you buy travel insurance?

sents.zh: 你的旅行是怎么开始的？
sents.p: nǐ de lǚ xíng shì zěn me kāi shǐ de
sents.en: How did your journey begin?

sents.zh: 铁路与公路平行。
sents.p: tiě lù yǔ gōng lù píng xíng
sents.en: The railroad is parallel to the road.

sents.zh: 他穿过公路。
sents.p: tā chuān guò gōng lù
sents.en: He crossed the street.

sents.zh: 你回来的时候我们再说。
sents.p: nǐ huí lai de shí hou wǒ men zài shuō
sents.en: We can talk when you get back.

sents.zh: 刚才的话，你可以再说一遍吗？
sents.p: gāng cái de huà nǐ kě yǐ zài shuō yī biàn ma
sents.en: Can you repeat what you said?

sents.zh: 那不是我故意的。
sents.p: nà bù shì wǒ gù yì de
sents.en: That wasn't my intention.

sents.zh: 那花闻起来很香。
sents.p: nà huā wén qǐ lai hěn xiāng
sents.en: That flower smells sweet.

sents.zh: 我听传闻说的。
sents.p: wǒ tīng chuán wén shuō de
sents.en: A little bird told me.

sents.zh: 他被视为村里最好的医生。
sents.p: tā bèi shì wéi cūn lǐ zuì hǎo de yī shēng
sents.en: He is regarded as the best doctor in the village.

sents.zh: 能不能麻烦你告诉我去邻村怎么走？
sents.p: néng bù néng má fan nǐ gào sù wǒ qù lín cūn zěn me zǒu
sents.en: Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?

sents.zh: 他有他的缺点，但是我爱他。
sents.p: tā yǒu tā de quē diǎn dàn shì wǒ ài tā
sents.en: I love him despite his faults.

sents.zh: 我们国家不缺石油。
sents.p: wǒ men guó jiā bù quē shí yóu
sents.en: We are not short of oil in this country.

sents.zh: 大家辛苦了！
sents.p: dà jiā xīn kǔ le
sents.en: Good job, everyone!

sents.zh: 他们工作的很辛苦。
sents.p: tā men gōng zuò de hěn xīn kǔ
sents.en: They work really hard.

sents.zh: 正好那个时候，公交车停下来了。
sents.p: zhèng hǎo nà gè shí hou gōng jiāo chē tíng xià lái le
sents.en: Just then, the bus stopped.

sents.zh: 我很抱歉回复晚了。
sents.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn huí fù wǎn le
sents.en: I'm sorry for the late response.

sents.zh: 我一直都相信你的判断。
sents.p: wǒ yī zhí dōu xiāng xìn nǐ de pàn duàn
sents.en: I've always trusted your judgment.

sents.zh: 我无法判断他的话是真是假。
sents.p: wǒ wú fǎ pàn duàn tā de huà shì zhēn shì jià
sents.en: I've no way of telling whether or not what he says is true.

sents.zh: 你给他们的钱会用到好处。
sents.p: nǐ gěi tā men de qián huì yòng dào hǎo chu
sents.en: The money you give them will be put to good use.

sents.zh: 我想这药会对您有好处的。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng zhè yào huì duì nín yǒu hǎo chu de
sents.en: I think this medicine will do you good.

sents.zh: 你是怎样庆祝生日的？
sents.p: nǐ shì zěn yàng qìng zhù shēng rì de
sents.en: How did you celebrate your birthday?

sents.zh: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。
sents.p: hé tong yǐ jīng dào shǒu le nà jiù chū qù qìng zhù yī xià ba
sents.en: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.

sents.zh: 她看上去很伤心。
sents.p: tā kàn shang qu hěn shāng xīn
sents.en: She looked sad.

sents.zh: 这个消息让她很伤心。
sents.p: zhè gè xiāo xi ràng tā hěn shāng xīn
sents.en: The news made her sad.

sents.zh: 他在艺术世家长大。
sents.p: tā zài yì shù shì jiā zhǎng dà
sents.en: He was raised in an artistic family.

sents.zh: 你要注意不要太自信。
sents.p: nǐ yào zhù yì bù yào tài zì xìn
sents.en: You should be careful not to become overconfident.

sents.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
sents.p: yào xiǎng chéng gōng zhǐ xū yào wú zhī hé zì xìn
sents.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.

sents.zh: 你读完那本小说了吗？
sents.p: nǐ dú wán nà běn xiǎo shuō le ma
sents.en: Have you finished reading that novel?

sents.zh: 我一直忙于写一部短篇小说。
sents.p: wǒ yī zhí máng yú xiě yī bù duǎn piān xiǎo shuō
sents.en: I've been busy writing a short story.

sents.zh: 今天相比往常，稍暖一些。
sents.p: jīn tiān xiāng bǐ wǎng cháng shāo nuǎn yī xiē
sents.en: Today's a bit warmer than usual.

sents.zh: 在这里稍微休息一下吧。
sents.p: zài zhè lǐ shāo wēi xiū xi yī xià ba
sents.en: Let's rest here.

sents.zh: 他不是医生，他是教师。
sents.p: tā bù shì yī shēng tā shì jiào shī
sents.en: He is not a doctor but a teacher.

sents.zh: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。
sents.p: jiào shī yòng shǒu zhǐ zhǐ zhe wǒ yào wǒ gēn tā zǒu
sents.en: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.

sents.zh: 人们应该被鼓励。
sents.p: rén men yīng gāi bèi gǔ lì
sents.en: People should be encouraged.

sents.zh: 他点头以示鼓励。
sents.p: tā diǎn tóu yǐ shì gǔ lì
sents.en: He nodded encouragingly.

sents.zh: 我们在一个工厂工作。
sents.p: wǒ men zài yī gè gōng chǎng gōng zuò
sents.en: We work in a factory.

sents.zh: 下周工厂可能会关。
sents.p: xià zhōu gōng chǎng kě néng huì guān
sents.en: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.

sents.zh: 他后悔在校时没用功读书。
sents.p: tā hòu huǐ zài xiào shí méi yòng gōng dú shū
sents.en: He regrets not having worked harder at school.

sents.zh: 不要做任何会让你后悔的事。
sents.p: bù yào zuò rèn hé huì ràng nǐ hòu huǐ de shì
sents.en: Don't do anything you'll regret.

units.intro: Grammar focus: 竟然; 难道…吗; 尽管

ex.zh: 下一场音乐会将在六月份举办。
ex.p: xià yī chǎng yīn yuè huì jiāng zài liù yuè fèn jǔ bàn
ex.en: The next concert will take place in June.

ex.zh: 您的名字被提到了。
ex.p: nín de míng zi bèi tí dào le
ex.en: Your name was mentioned.

items.en: not equal to; not as good as

ex.zh: 我做得不如以前好了。
ex.p: wǒ zuò de bù rú yǐ qián hǎo le
ex.en: I don't do that as well as I used to.

ex.zh: 坐而言不如起而行。
ex.p: zuò ér yán bù rú qǐ ér xíng
ex.en: Actions speak louder than words.

ex.zh: 顾客永远是正确的吗？
ex.p: gù kè yǒng yuǎn shì zhèng què de ma
ex.en: Is the customer always right?

ex.zh: 他们说高尔夫在日本很流行。
ex.p: tā men shuō gāo ěr fu zài rì běn hěn liú xíng
ex.en: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.

ex.zh: 红色不流行了。
ex.p: hóng sè bù liú xíng le
ex.en: Red is out of fashion.

ex.zh: 我想用信用卡支付。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yòng xìn yòng kǎ zhī fù
ex.en: I'd like to pay by credit card.

ex.zh: 每位会员每月需支付一万日元。
ex.p: měi wèi huì yuán měi yuè xū zhī fù yī wàn rì yuán
ex.en: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.

ex.zh: 您要赶快些。
ex.p: nín yào gǎn kuài xiē
ex.en: You have to hurry.

ex.zh: 只有你回答了这个问题。
ex.p: zhǐ yǒu nǐ huí dá le zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: Only you answered the question.

ex.zh: 总统拒绝回答那个问题。
ex.p: zǒng tǒng jù jué huí dá nà gè wèn tí
ex.en: The President refused to answer the question.

ex.zh: 北极熊正在死去。
ex.p: běi jí xióng zhèng zài sǐ qù
ex.en: The polar bears are dying.

ex.zh: 原谅我早上这么早给你打电话。
ex.p: yuán liàng wǒ zǎo shang zhè me zǎo gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
ex.en: Please excuse me for calling you so early in the morning.

ex.zh: 我们已经原谅你了。
ex.p: wǒ men yǐ jīng yuán liàng nǐ le
ex.en: We've forgiven you.

ex.zh: 这本小说的作者是谁？
ex.p: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de zuò zhě shì shéi
ex.en: Who's the author of this story?

ex.zh: 这些产品质量同等。
ex.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn zhì liàng tóng děng
ex.en: These products are of the same quality.

ex.zh: 数量不如质量。
ex.p: shù liàng bù rú zhì liàng
ex.en: Quality is more important than quantity.

ex.zh: 谢谢你答应到来。
ex.p: xiè xie nǐ dā ying dào lái
ex.en: Thanks for agreeing to come.

ex.zh: 谢谢您答应到来。
ex.p: xiè xie nín dā ying dào lái
ex.en: Thanks for agreeing to come.

ex.zh: 你度过愉快的时光了吗？
ex.p: nǐ dù guò yú kuài de shí guāng le ma
ex.en: Did you have a good time?

ex.zh: 你怎么样？旅游愉快吗？
ex.p: nǐ zěn me yàng lǚ yóu yú kuài ma
ex.en: How are you? Did you have a good trip?

ex.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。
ex.p: zhǔn què xìng zài jì suàn zhōng hěn zhòng yào
ex.en: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.

ex.zh: 我下周会详细说明的。
ex.p: wǒ xià zhōu huì xiáng xì shuō míng de
ex.en: I'll explain it in detail next week.

ex.zh: 他们正努力降低成本。
ex.p: tā men zhèng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn
ex.en: They're trying to keep costs down.

ex.zh: 明天他会在月球降落。
ex.p: míng tiān tā huì zài yuè qiú jiàng luò
ex.en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

ex.zh: 此处禁止停车。
ex.p: cǐ chù jìn zhǐ tíng chē
ex.en: Parking is prohibited here.

ex.zh: 日本米市场禁止进口。
ex.p: rì běn mǐ shì chǎng jìn zhǐ jìn kǒu
ex.en: Japan's rice market is closed to imports.

ex.zh: 我们只须保持冷静。
ex.p: wǒ men zhǐ xū bǎo chí lěng jìng
ex.en: We just need to stay calm.

ex.zh: 大家需要冷静下来。
ex.p: dà jiā xū yào lěng jìng xià lai
ex.en: Everybody needs to calm down.

ex.zh: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？
ex.p: wǒ yào qù gòu wù nǐ yào gēn zhe lái ma
ex.en: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?

ex.zh: 什么时候去购物？
ex.p: shén me shí hou qù gòu wù
ex.en: When are we going shopping?

ex.zh: 汽车的数量在增长。
ex.p: qì chē de shù liàng zài zēng zhǎng
ex.en: The number of cars is on the increase.

ex.zh: 上海的人口数量和东京相当。
ex.p: shàng hǎi de rén kǒu shù liàng hé dōng jīng xiāng dāng
ex.en: The population of Shanghai is as large as that of Tokyo.

ex.zh: 我喜欢和你一起吃早餐。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan hé nǐ yī qǐ chī zǎo cān
ex.en: I like having breakfast with you.

ex.zh: 我穿著我的睡衣吃早餐。
ex.p: wǒ chuān zhù wǒ de shuì yī chī zǎo cān
ex.en: I ate breakfast in my pajamas.

ex.zh: 当我看到这张图片的时候总是哭。
ex.p: dāng wǒ kàn dào zhè zhāng tú piàn de shí hou zǒng shì kū
ex.en: I always cry when I see this picture.

ex.zh: 我会给你看图片。
ex.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ kàn tú piàn
ex.en: I will show you the picture.

ex.zh: 今天相比往常，稍暖一些。
ex.p: jīn tiān xiāng bǐ wǎng cháng shāo nuǎn yī xiē
ex.en: Today's a bit warmer than usual.

ex.zh: 我觉得她很勇敢。
ex.p: wǒ jué de tā hěn yǒng gǎn
ex.en: I think she is very brave.

ex.zh: 你非常勇敢。
ex.p: nǐ fēi cháng yǒng gǎn
ex.en: You are very brave.

ex.zh: 我购买一本书花费了三十美元。
ex.p: wǒ gòu mǎi yī běn shū huā fèi le sān shí měi yuán
ex.en: I spent thirty dollars on a book.

ex.zh: 您现在不必购买任何东西。
ex.p: nín xiàn zài bù bì gòu mǎi rèn hé dōng xi
ex.en: You don't have to buy anything right now.

ex.zh: 旅行最快的方式是乘飞机。
ex.p: lǚ xíng zuì kuài de fāng shì shì chéng fēi jī
ex.en: The fastest way to travel is by plane.

ex.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
ex.p: chuán zhǎng yào wèi chéng kè ān quán fù zé
ex.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.

lessons.html:
HSK 4 · 第59单元

Services: bank, hospital, renting

Grammar focus: 竟然; 难道…吗; 尽管

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 下一场音乐会将在六月份举办。
sents.p: xià yī chǎng yīn yuè huì jiāng zài liù yuè fèn jǔ bàn
sents.en: The next concert will take place in June.

sents.zh: 您的名字被提到了。
sents.p: nín de míng zi bèi tí dào le
sents.en: Your name was mentioned.

sents.zh: 我做得不如以前好了。
sents.p: wǒ zuò de bù rú yǐ qián hǎo le
sents.en: I don't do that as well as I used to.

sents.zh: 坐而言不如起而行。
sents.p: zuò ér yán bù rú qǐ ér xíng
sents.en: Actions speak louder than words.

sents.zh: 顾客永远是正确的吗？
sents.p: gù kè yǒng yuǎn shì zhèng què de ma
sents.en: Is the customer always right?

sents.zh: 他们说高尔夫在日本很流行。
sents.p: tā men shuō gāo ěr fu zài rì běn hěn liú xíng
sents.en: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.

sents.zh: 红色不流行了。
sents.p: hóng sè bù liú xíng le
sents.en: Red is out of fashion.

sents.zh: 我想用信用卡支付。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yòng xìn yòng kǎ zhī fù
sents.en: I'd like to pay by credit card.

sents.zh: 每位会员每月需支付一万日元。
sents.p: měi wèi huì yuán měi yuè xū zhī fù yī wàn rì yuán
sents.en: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.

sents.zh: 您要赶快些。
sents.p: nín yào gǎn kuài xiē
sents.en: You have to hurry.

sents.zh: 只有你回答了这个问题。
sents.p: zhǐ yǒu nǐ huí dá le zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: Only you answered the question.

sents.zh: 总统拒绝回答那个问题。
sents.p: zǒng tǒng jù jué huí dá nà gè wèn tí
sents.en: The President refused to answer the question.

sents.zh: 北极熊正在死去。
sents.p: běi jí xióng zhèng zài sǐ qù
sents.en: The polar bears are dying.

sents.zh: 原谅我早上这么早给你打电话。
sents.p: yuán liàng wǒ zǎo shang zhè me zǎo gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
sents.en: Please excuse me for calling you so early in the morning.

sents.zh: 我们已经原谅你了。
sents.p: wǒ men yǐ jīng yuán liàng nǐ le
sents.en: We've forgiven you.

sents.zh: 这本小说的作者是谁？
sents.p: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de zuò zhě shì shéi
sents.en: Who's the author of this story?

sents.zh: 这些产品质量同等。
sents.p: zhè xiē chǎn pǐn zhì liàng tóng děng
sents.en: These products are of the same quality.

sents.zh: 数量不如质量。
sents.p: shù liàng bù rú zhì liàng
sents.en: Quality is more important than quantity.

sents.zh: 谢谢你答应到来。
sents.p: xiè xie nǐ dā ying dào lái
sents.en: Thanks for agreeing to come.

sents.zh: 谢谢您答应到来。
sents.p: xiè xie nín dā ying dào lái
sents.en: Thanks for agreeing to come.

sents.zh: 你度过愉快的时光了吗？
sents.p: nǐ dù guò yú kuài de shí guāng le ma
sents.en: Did you have a good time?

sents.zh: 你怎么样？旅游愉快吗？
sents.p: nǐ zěn me yàng lǚ yóu yú kuài ma
sents.en: How are you? Did you have a good trip?

sents.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。
sents.p: zhǔn què xìng zài jì suàn zhōng hěn zhòng yào
sents.en: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.

sents.zh: 我下周会详细说明的。
sents.p: wǒ xià zhōu huì xiáng xì shuō míng de
sents.en: I'll explain it in detail next week.

sents.zh: 他们正努力降低成本。
sents.p: tā men zhèng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn
sents.en: They're trying to keep costs down.

sents.zh: 明天他会在月球降落。
sents.p: míng tiān tā huì zài yuè qiú jiàng luò
sents.en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

sents.zh: 此处禁止停车。
sents.p: cǐ chù jìn zhǐ tíng chē
sents.en: Parking is prohibited here.

sents.zh: 日本米市场禁止进口。
sents.p: rì běn mǐ shì chǎng jìn zhǐ jìn kǒu
sents.en: Japan's rice market is closed to imports.

sents.zh: 我们只须保持冷静。
sents.p: wǒ men zhǐ xū bǎo chí lěng jìng
sents.en: We just need to stay calm.

sents.zh: 大家需要冷静下来。
sents.p: dà jiā xū yào lěng jìng xià lai
sents.en: Everybody needs to calm down.

sents.zh: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？
sents.p: wǒ yào qù gòu wù nǐ yào gēn zhe lái ma
sents.en: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?

sents.zh: 什么时候去购物？
sents.p: shén me shí hou qù gòu wù
sents.en: When are we going shopping?

sents.zh: 汽车的数量在增长。
sents.p: qì chē de shù liàng zài zēng zhǎng
sents.en: The number of cars is on the increase.

sents.zh: 上海的人口数量和东京相当。
sents.p: shàng hǎi de rén kǒu shù liàng hé dōng jīng xiāng dāng
sents.en: The population of Shanghai is as large as that of Tokyo.

sents.zh: 我喜欢和你一起吃早餐。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan hé nǐ yī qǐ chī zǎo cān
sents.en: I like having breakfast with you.

sents.zh: 我穿著我的睡衣吃早餐。
sents.p: wǒ chuān zhù wǒ de shuì yī chī zǎo cān
sents.en: I ate breakfast in my pajamas.

sents.zh: 当我看到这张图片的时候总是哭。
sents.p: dāng wǒ kàn dào zhè zhāng tú piàn de shí hou zǒng shì kū
sents.en: I always cry when I see this picture.

sents.zh: 我会给你看图片。
sents.p: wǒ huì gěi nǐ kàn tú piàn
sents.en: I will show you the picture.

sents.zh: 今天相比往常，稍暖一些。
sents.p: jīn tiān xiāng bǐ wǎng cháng shāo nuǎn yī xiē
sents.en: Today's a bit warmer than usual.

sents.zh: 我觉得她很勇敢。
sents.p: wǒ jué de tā hěn yǒng gǎn
sents.en: I think she is very brave.

sents.zh: 你非常勇敢。
sents.p: nǐ fēi cháng yǒng gǎn
sents.en: You are very brave.

sents.zh: 我购买一本书花费了三十美元。
sents.p: wǒ gòu mǎi yī běn shū huā fèi le sān shí měi yuán
sents.en: I spent thirty dollars on a book.

sents.zh: 您现在不必购买任何东西。
sents.p: nín xiàn zài bù bì gòu mǎi rèn hé dōng xi
sents.en: You don't have to buy anything right now.

sents.zh: 旅行最快的方式是乘飞机。
sents.p: lǚ xíng zuì kuài de fāng shì shì chéng fēi jī
sents.en: The fastest way to travel is by plane.

sents.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
sents.p: chuán zhǎng yào wèi chéng kè ān quán fù zé
sents.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.

units.title: Services: bank, hospital, renting
units.intro: Grammar focus: 竟然; 难道…吗; 尽管

ex.zh: 今天早晨被头给疼醒了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo chén bèi tóu gěi téng xǐng le
ex.en: I woke up with a headache this morning.

ex.zh: 在早晨，我总是喝一杯咖啡。
ex.p: zài zǎo chén wǒ zǒng shì hē yī bēi kā fēi
ex.en: I always drink a cup of coffee in the morning.

ex.zh: 我刚把你家的卫生做完。
ex.p: wǒ gāng bǎ nǐ jiā de wèi shēng zuò wán
ex.en: I just finished cleaning your place.

ex.zh: 我当时在卫生间。
ex.p: wǒ dāng shí zài wèi shēng jiān
ex.en: I was in the bathroom.

ex.zh: 他吃了一盒巧克力。
ex.p: tā chī le yī hé qiǎo kè lì
ex.en: He ate a box of chocolates.

ex.zh: 孩子们喜欢巧克力。
ex.p: hái zi men xǐ huan qiǎo kè lì
ex.en: Children like chocolate.

items.en: to reinforce; to strengthen; to enhance
way of handling sth; method for making

ex.zh: 请问鸡蛋要什么做法？
ex.p: qǐng wèn jī dàn yào shén me zuò fǎ
ex.en: How would you like your eggs?

ex.zh: 他可以为自己的父亲而骄傲。
ex.p: tā kě yǐ wèi zì jǐ de fù qīn ér jiāo ào
ex.en: He can be proud of his father.

ex.zh: 她可以为她的女儿感到骄傲。
ex.p: tā kě yǐ wèi tā de nǚ ér gǎn dào jiāo ào
ex.en: She may be proud of her daughter.

ex.zh: 你不是歌手。
ex.p: nǐ bù shì gē shǒu
ex.en: You're no singer.

ex.zh: 他不是歌手，但是个演员。
ex.p: tā bù shì gē shǒu dàn shì gè yǎn yuán
ex.en: He is not a singer, but an actor.

ex.zh: 他是非常有想像力的作家。
ex.p: tā shì fēi cháng yǒu xiǎng xiàng lì de zuò jiā
ex.en: He is a very imaginative writer.

ex.zh: 你觉得那些日本作家怎么样？
ex.p: nǐ jué de nà xiē rì běn zuò jiā zěn me yàng
ex.en: What do you think of those Japanese writers?

items.en: in all parts of (a country); various regions
to reduce; to lower; to bring down

ex.zh: 她降低了收音机的音量。
ex.p: tā jiàng dī le shōu yīn jī de yīn liàng
ex.en: She turned down the radio.

ex.zh: 他们正努力降低成本。
ex.p: tā men zhèng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn
ex.en: They're trying to keep costs down.

ex.zh: 课程下周开始。
ex.p: kè chéng xià zhōu kāi shǐ
ex.en: Classes begin next week.

ex.zh: 她全身都疼。
ex.p: tā quán shēn dōu téng
ex.en: She was aching all over.

ex.zh: 我全身疼痛。
ex.p: wǒ quán shēn téng tòng
ex.en: My whole body hurts.

items.en: along with; in the wake of

ex.zh: 看起来全都太奇怪了。
ex.p: kàn qǐ lai quán dōu tài qí guài le
ex.en: It all seems so strange.

ex.zh: 他们全都来了。
ex.p: tā men quán dōu lái le
ex.en: They all have come.

ex.zh: 出国的人数一直在增加。
ex.p: chū guó de rén shù yī zhí zài zēng jiā
ex.en: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.

ex.zh: 听说最近失业者人数正在增加
ex.p: tīng shuō zuì jìn shī yè zhě rén shù zhèng zài zēng jiā
ex.en: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.

ex.zh: 这是我所知道的最好的餐厅。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ suǒ zhī dào de zuì hǎo de cān tīng
ex.en: This is the best restaurant I know.

ex.zh: 我推荐这个餐厅。
ex.p: wǒ tuī jiàn zhè gè cān tīng
ex.en: I can recommend this restaurant.

ex.zh: 我对亚洲的历史很感兴趣。
ex.p: wǒ duì yà zhōu de lì shǐ hěn gǎn xìng qù
ex.en: I'm interested in Asian history.

ex.zh: 日本在亚洲。
ex.p: rì běn zài yà zhōu
ex.en: Japan is in Asia.

ex.zh: 我为昨天发生的事道歉。
ex.p: wǒ wèi zuó tiān fā shēng de shì dào qiàn
ex.en: I apologize for yesterday.

ex.zh: 为什么我要向你道歉？
ex.p: wèi shén me wǒ yào xiàng nǐ dào qiàn
ex.en: Why should I apologize to you?

ex.zh: 今天下午到我家来一趟。
ex.p: jīn tiān xià wǔ dào wǒ jiā lái yī tāng
ex.en: Come to my house this afternoon.

ex.zh: 我们要你做队长。
ex.p: wǒ men yào nǐ zuò duì zhǎng
ex.en: We want you to be the team captain.

ex.zh: 我就只告诉你，我不喜欢我们的新队长。
ex.p: wǒ jiù zhǐ gào sù nǐ wǒ bù xǐ huan wǒ men de xīn duì zhǎng
ex.en: Between you and me, I don't like our new team captain.

ex.zh: 我认为这外套应该适合你。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè wài tào yīng gāi shì hé nǐ
ex.en: I think this coat should fit you.

ex.zh: 他穿上了黑色的外套。
ex.p: tā chuān shang le hēi sè de wài tào
ex.en: He put on the black coat.

ex.zh: 我听到聚会的事很高兴。
ex.p: wǒ tīng dào jù huì de shì hěn gāo xìng
ex.en: I'm very happy to hear about the party.

ex.zh: 聚会上我和他谈得很愉快。
ex.p: jù huì shàng wǒ hé tā tán de hěn yú kuài
ex.en: I enjoyed talking with him at the party.

items.en: to use in; to use on; to use for

ex.zh: 我们每周在这儿聚一次。
ex.p: wǒ men měi zhōu zài zhèr jù yī cì
ex.en: We meet here once a week.

ex.zh: 会不会只有我一个人去聚会？
ex.p: huì bù huì zhǐ yǒu wǒ yī gè rén qù jù huì
ex.en: Will I be the only one going to the party?

ex.zh: 万幸，没乘客受伤。
ex.p: wàn xìng méi chéng kè shòu shāng
ex.en: Fortunately, no passengers were injured.

ex.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
ex.p: chuán zhǎng yào wèi chéng kè ān quán fù zé
ex.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.

ex.zh: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。
ex.p: nà jiù shì nà tái tā yòng lái xiě wén zhāng de diàn nǎo
ex.en: That's the computer he used to write the article.

ex.zh: 那种鞋子用来登山是不行的。
ex.p: nà zhǒng xié zǐ yòng lái dēng shān shì bù xíng de
ex.en: Those shoes won't do for climbing.

ex.zh: 要是你不在听广播的话，就关掉它。
ex.p: yào shi nǐ bù zài tīng guǎng bō de huà jiù guān diào tā
ex.en: If you're not listening to the radio, turn it off.

ex.zh: 附近有没有青年旅舍？
ex.p: fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu qīng nián lǚ shè
ex.en: Is there a youth hostel near here?

sents.zh: 我全身疼痛。
sents.p: wǒ quán shēn téng tòng
sents.en: My whole body hurts.

sents.zh: 看起来全都太奇怪了。
sents.p: kàn qǐ lai quán dōu tài qí guài le
sents.en: It all seems so strange.

sents.zh: 他们全都来了。
sents.p: tā men quán dōu lái le
sents.en: They all have come.

sents.zh: 出国的人数一直在增加。
sents.p: chū guó de rén shù yī zhí zài zēng jiā
sents.en: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.

sents.zh: 听说最近失业者人数正在增加
sents.p: tīng shuō zuì jìn shī yè zhě rén shù zhèng zài zēng jiā
sents.en: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.

sents.zh: 这是我所知道的最好的餐厅。
sents.p: zhè shì wǒ suǒ zhī dào de zuì hǎo de cān tīng
sents.en: This is the best restaurant I know.

sents.zh: 我推荐这个餐厅。
sents.p: wǒ tuī jiàn zhè gè cān tīng
sents.en: I can recommend this restaurant.

sents.zh: 我对亚洲的历史很感兴趣。
sents.p: wǒ duì yà zhōu de lì shǐ hěn gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: I'm interested in Asian history.

sents.zh: 日本在亚洲。
sents.p: rì běn zài yà zhōu
sents.en: Japan is in Asia.

sents.zh: 我为昨天发生的事道歉。
sents.p: wǒ wèi zuó tiān fā shēng de shì dào qiàn
sents.en: I apologize for yesterday.

sents.zh: 为什么我要向你道歉？
sents.p: wèi shén me wǒ yào xiàng nǐ dào qiàn
sents.en: Why should I apologize to you?

sents.zh: 今天下午到我家来一趟。
sents.p: jīn tiān xià wǔ dào wǒ jiā lái yī tāng
sents.en: Come to my house this afternoon.

sents.zh: 我们要你做队长。
sents.p: wǒ men yào nǐ zuò duì zhǎng
sents.en: We want you to be the team captain.

sents.zh: 我就只告诉你，我不喜欢我们的新队长。
sents.p: wǒ jiù zhǐ gào sù nǐ wǒ bù xǐ huan wǒ men de xīn duì zhǎng
sents.en: Between you and me, I don't like our new team captain.

sents.zh: 我认为这外套应该适合你。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè wài tào yīng gāi shì hé nǐ
sents.en: I think this coat should fit you.

sents.zh: 他穿上了黑色的外套。
sents.p: tā chuān shang le hēi sè de wài tào
sents.en: He put on the black coat.

sents.zh: 我听到聚会的事很高兴。
sents.p: wǒ tīng dào jù huì de shì hěn gāo xìng
sents.en: I'm very happy to hear about the party.

sents.zh: 聚会上我和他谈得很愉快。
sents.p: jù huì shàng wǒ hé tā tán de hěn yú kuài
sents.en: I enjoyed talking with him at the party.

sents.zh: 我们每周在这儿聚一次。
sents.p: wǒ men měi zhōu zài zhèr jù yī cì
sents.en: We meet here once a week.

sents.zh: 会不会只有我一个人去聚会？
sents.p: huì bù huì zhǐ yǒu wǒ yī gè rén qù jù huì
sents.en: Will I be the only one going to the party?

sents.zh: 万幸，没乘客受伤。
sents.p: wàn xìng méi chéng kè shòu shāng
sents.en: Fortunately, no passengers were injured.

sents.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
sents.p: chuán zhǎng yào wèi chéng kè ān quán fù zé
sents.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.

sents.zh: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。
sents.p: nà jiù shì nà tái tā yòng lái xiě wén zhāng de diàn nǎo
sents.en: That's the computer he used to write the article.

sents.zh: 那种鞋子用来登山是不行的。
sents.p: nà zhǒng xié zǐ yòng lái dēng shān shì bù xíng de
sents.en: Those shoes won't do for climbing.

sents.zh: 要是你不在听广播的话，就关掉它。
sents.p: yào shi nǐ bù zài tīng guǎng bō de huà jiù guān diào tā
sents.en: If you're not listening to the radio, turn it off.

sents.zh: 附近有没有青年旅舍？
sents.p: fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu qīng nián lǚ shè
sents.en: Is there a youth hostel near here?

units.title: Education and learning
units.intro: Grammar focus: 不仅…还; 甚至; 否则

ex.zh: 第二天我的腿很酸。
ex.p: dì èr tiān wǒ de tuǐ hěn suān
ex.en: I had sore legs the next day.

ex.zh: 酸雨不是自然现象。
ex.p: suān yù bù shì zì rán xiàn xiàng
ex.en: Acid rain isn't a natural phenomenon.

ex.zh: 我能用一下你们的厕所吗？
ex.p: wǒ néng yòng yī xià nǐ men de cè suǒ ma
ex.en: May I use your toilet?

ex.zh: 女厕所在三楼。
ex.p: nǚ cè suǒ zài sān lóu
ex.en: The ladies' room is on the third floor.

items.en: whatever; no matter what (who, how etc)

ex.zh: 不论发生什么事，我都会在你身边。
ex.p: bù lùn fā shēng shén me shì wǒ dū huì zài nǐ shēn biān
ex.en: I will stand by you whatever happens.

ex.zh: 不论我做什么，她都说我能做得更好。
ex.p: bù lùn wǒ zuò shén me tā dōu shuō wǒ néng zuò de gēng hǎo
ex.en: No matter what I do, she says I can do better.

items.en: for example; for instance; such as
to attach importance to sth; to value

ex.zh: 汽车的数量在增长。
ex.p: qì chē de shù liàng zài zēng zhǎng
ex.en: The number of cars is on the increase.

ex.zh: 那是一个安静的夜晚。
ex.p: nà shì yī gè ān jìng de yè wǎn
ex.en: It was a quiet night.

ex.zh: 她在夜晚望著月亮。
ex.p: tā zài yè wǎn wàng zhù yuè liang
ex.en: At night, she gazed at the moon.

ex.zh: 帮我抬包裹。
ex.p: bāng wǒ tái bāo guǒ
ex.en: Help me lift the package.

ex.zh: 我对自己说，“那是个好主意。”
ex.p: wǒ duì zì jǐ shuō nà shì gè hǎo zhǔ yi
ex.en: I said to myself, "That's a good idea."

ex.zh: 我说服他放弃了这个主意。
ex.p: wǒ shuō fú tā fàng qì le zhè gè zhǔ yi
ex.en: I talked him out of the idea.

ex.zh: 我将水倒入了桶中。
ex.p: wǒ jiāng shuǐ dào rù le tǒng zhōng
ex.en: I poured water into the bucket.

ex.zh: 这桶装满了水。
ex.p: zhè tǒng zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ
ex.en: The bucket was full of water.

ex.zh: 她为我们煮了一顿美味的晚餐。
ex.p: tā wèi wǒ men zhǔ le yī dùn měi wèi de wǎn cān
ex.en: She cooked us a delicious dinner.

ex.zh: 我们在吃过晚餐后出去散步了。
ex.p: wǒ men zài chī guò wǎn cān hòu chū qù sàn bù le
ex.en: We went out for a walk after dinner.

items.en: chair of a board; president of a university

ex.zh: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。
ex.p: tā dé dào le bǐ wǒ men hái gāo de fēn shù
ex.en: He got a better score than us.

items.en: to enter a school or college

ex.zh: 我听说你通过了入学考试。恭喜你了！
ex.p: wǒ tīng shuō nǐ tōng guò le rù xué kǎo shì gōng xǐ nǐ le
ex.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!

ex.zh: 他在入学考试中失败了。
ex.p: tā zài rù xué kǎo shì zhōng shī bài le
ex.en: He failed the entrance exam.

items.en: to write an essay; composition (student essay)

ex.zh: 这篇英语作文离完美还差得远。
ex.p: zhè piān yīng yǔ zuò wén lí wán měi hái chà de yuǎn
ex.en: This English essay is far from perfect.

items.en: self-study; to study on one's own

units.title: Education and learning
units.intro: Grammar focus: 不仅…还; 甚至; 否则

ex.zh: 他们在仔细观看发生了什么。
ex.p: tā men zài zǐ xì guān kàn fā shēng le shén me
ex.en: They are watching what's happening closely.

ex.zh: 他把奖金存到银行了。
ex.p: tā bǎ jiǎng jīn cún dào yín háng le
ex.en: He deposited the prize money in the bank.

ex.zh: 那幅画有多少年了？
ex.p: nà fú huà yǒu duō shǎo nián le
ex.en: How old is that painting?

ex.zh: 他是个日本少年。
ex.p: tā shì gè rì běn shào nián
ex.en: He's a Japanese boy.

ex.zh: 八减去三就能得到五。
ex.p: bā jiǎn qù sān jiù néng dé dào wǔ
ex.en: Subtract three from eight and you get five.

ex.zh: 他是个绝对不会偷工减料的人。
ex.p: tā shì gè jué duì bù huì tōu gōng jiǎn liào de rén
ex.en: He is a person who never cuts corners.

items.en: to feel unwell; to suffer pain

ex.zh: 我这两天感觉难受。
ex.p: wǒ zhè liǎng tiān gǎn jué nán shòu
ex.en: I've been feeling sick for the past few days.

ex.zh: 我难受三周了。
ex.p: wǒ nán shòu sān zhōu le
ex.en: I was sore for three weeks.

ex.zh: 我打算今晚和她约会。
ex.p: wǒ dǎ suàn jīn wǎn hé tā yuē huì
ex.en: I'm seeing her this evening.

ex.zh: 你觉得我明天约会穿什么好呢？
ex.p: nǐ jué de wǒ míng tiān yuē huì chuān shén me hǎo ne
ex.en: What do you think I should wear on my date tomorrow?

ex.zh: 她每周末都打高尔夫球。
ex.p: tā měi zhōu mò dōu dǎ gāo ěr fū qiú
ex.en: She plays golf every weekend.

ex.zh: 我爸爸会在这周末回家。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba huì zài zhè zhōu mò huí jiā
ex.en: My father will come home at the end of this week.

ex.zh: 我必须仔细做。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū zǐ xì zuò
ex.en: I must do that carefully.

ex.zh: 请仔细洗牌。
ex.p: qǐng zǐ xì xǐ pái
ex.en: Please shuffle the cards carefully.

ex.zh: 我受不了这大热天了。
ex.p: wǒ shòu bù liǎo zhè dà rè tiān le
ex.en: I can't put up with the heat any longer.

ex.zh: 我受不了他的傲慢。
ex.p: wǒ shòu bù liǎo tā de ào màn
ex.en: I can't stand his arrogance.

ex.zh: 这本书非常厚。
ex.p: zhè běn shū fēi cháng hòu
ex.en: This book is very thick.

ex.zh: 冰厚得足以让我在上面走路。
ex.p: bīng hòu de zú yǐ ràng wǒ zài shàng miàn zǒu lù
ex.en: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.

ex.zh: 你为什么想成为护士呢？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me xiǎng chéng wéi hù shi ne
ex.en: Why do you want to be a nurse?

ex.zh: 她可能是护士。我不太肯定。
ex.p: tā kě néng shì hù shi wǒ bù tài kěn dìng
ex.en: She may be a nurse. I am not sure.

ex.zh: 博物馆的参观者中有少数是外国人。
ex.p: bó wù guǎn de cān guān zhě zhōng yǒu shǎo shù shì wài guó rén
ex.en: There was a sprinkling of foreigners among the visitors in the museum.

ex.zh: 顺便说一句，你最近见过他吗？
ex.p: shùn biàn shuō yī jù nǐ zuì jìn jiàn guò tā ma
ex.en: By the way, have you seen him lately?

ex.zh: 顺便问一句，你今晚有空吗？
ex.p: shùn biàn wèn yī jù nǐ jīn wǎn yǒu kōng ma
ex.en: By the way, are you free tonight?

ex.zh: 我们的友谊受到了考验。
ex.p: wǒ men de yǒu yì shòu dào le kǎo yàn
ex.en: Our friendship was put to the test.

ex.zh: 友谊紧紧联系着我们。
ex.p: yǒu yì jǐn jǐn lián xì zhe wǒ men
ex.en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.

ex.zh: 我的兄弟是个笨蛋。
ex.p: wǒ de xiōng dì shì gè bèn dàn
ex.en: My brother is an idiot.

ex.zh: 我不是笨蛋。
ex.p: wǒ bù shì bèn dàn
ex.en: I'm not stupid.

ex.zh: 她没像你那样有耐心。
ex.p: tā méi xiàng nǐ nà yàng yǒu nài xīn
ex.en: She doesn't have as much patience as you do.

ex.zh: 她非常周到和耐心。
ex.p: tā fēi cháng zhōu dào hé nài xīn
ex.en: She is very thoughtful and patient.

items.en: to be far from; to keep away from

ex.zh: 儿童应该远离河流。有危险。
ex.p: ér tóng yīng gāi yuǎn lí hé liú yǒu wēi xiǎn
ex.en: Children should keep away from the river. It's dangerous.

items.en: to play a joke; to make fun of

ex.zh: 你觉得我是在开玩笑吗？
ex.p: nǐ jué de wǒ shì zài kāi wán xiào ma
ex.en: Do you think I'm joking?

ex.zh: 这不是一件开玩笑的事。
ex.p: zhè bù shì yī jiàn kāi wán xiào de shì
ex.en: This isn't a joking matter.

ex.zh: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

HSK 4 · 第62单元

Education and learning

Grammar focus: 不仅…还; 甚至; 否则

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 他们在仔细观看发生了什么。
sents.p: tā men zài zǐ xì guān kàn fā shēng le shén me
sents.en: They are watching what's happening closely.

sents.zh: 他把奖金存到银行了。
sents.p: tā bǎ jiǎng jīn cún dào yín háng le
sents.en: He deposited the prize money in the bank.

sents.zh: 那幅画有多少年了？
sents.p: nà fú huà yǒu duō shǎo nián le
sents.en: How old is that painting?

sents.zh: 他是个日本少年。
sents.p: tā shì gè rì běn shào nián
sents.en: He's a Japanese boy.

sents.zh: 八减去三就能得到五。
sents.p: bā jiǎn qù sān jiù néng dé dào wǔ
sents.en: Subtract three from eight and you get five.

sents.zh: 他是个绝对不会偷工减料的人。
sents.p: tā shì gè jué duì bù huì tōu gōng jiǎn liào de rén
sents.en: He is a person who never cuts corners.

sents.zh: 我这两天感觉难受。
sents.p: wǒ zhè liǎng tiān gǎn jué nán shòu
sents.en: I've been feeling sick for the past few days.

sents.zh: 我难受三周了。
sents.p: wǒ nán shòu sān zhōu le
sents.en: I was sore for three weeks.

sents.zh: 我打算今晚和她约会。
sents.p: wǒ dǎ suàn jīn wǎn hé tā yuē huì
sents.en: I'm seeing her this evening.

sents.zh: 你觉得我明天约会穿什么好呢？
sents.p: nǐ jué de wǒ míng tiān yuē huì chuān shén me hǎo ne
sents.en: What do you think I should wear on my date tomorrow?

sents.zh: 她每周末都打高尔夫球。
sents.p: tā měi zhōu mò dōu dǎ gāo ěr fū qiú
sents.en: She plays golf every weekend.

sents.zh: 我爸爸会在这周末回家。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba huì zài zhè zhōu mò huí jiā
sents.en: My father will come home at the end of this week.

sents.zh: 我必须仔细做。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū zǐ xì zuò
sents.en: I must do that carefully.

sents.zh: 请仔细洗牌。
sents.p: qǐng zǐ xì xǐ pái
sents.en: Please shuffle the cards carefully.

sents.zh: 我受不了这大热天了。
sents.p: wǒ shòu bù liǎo zhè dà rè tiān le
sents.en: I can't put up with the heat any longer.

sents.zh: 我受不了他的傲慢。
sents.p: wǒ shòu bù liǎo tā de ào màn
sents.en: I can't stand his arrogance.

sents.zh: 这本书非常厚。
sents.p: zhè běn shū fēi cháng hòu
sents.en: This book is very thick.

sents.zh: 冰厚得足以让我在上面走路。
sents.p: bīng hòu de zú yǐ ràng wǒ zài shàng miàn zǒu lù
sents.en: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.

sents.zh: 你为什么想成为护士呢？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me xiǎng chéng wéi hù shi ne
sents.en: Why do you want to be a nurse?

sents.zh: 她可能是护士。我不太肯定。
sents.p: tā kě néng shì hù shi wǒ bù tài kěn dìng
sents.en: She may be a nurse. I am not sure.

sents.zh: 博物馆的参观者中有少数是外国人。
sents.p: bó wù guǎn de cān guān zhě zhōng yǒu shǎo shù shì wài guó rén
sents.en: There was a sprinkling of foreigners among the visitors in the museum.

sents.zh: 顺便说一句，你最近见过他吗？
sents.p: shùn biàn shuō yī jù nǐ zuì jìn jiàn guò tā ma
sents.en: By the way, have you seen him lately?

sents.zh: 顺便问一句，你今晚有空吗？
sents.p: shùn biàn wèn yī jù nǐ jīn wǎn yǒu kōng ma
sents.en: By the way, are you free tonight?

sents.zh: 我们的友谊受到了考验。
sents.p: wǒ men de yǒu yì shòu dào le kǎo yàn
sents.en: Our friendship was put to the test.

sents.zh: 友谊紧紧联系着我们。
sents.p: yǒu yì jǐn jǐn lián xì zhe wǒ men
sents.en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.

sents.zh: 我的兄弟是个笨蛋。
sents.p: wǒ de xiōng dì shì gè bèn dàn
sents.en: My brother is an idiot.

sents.zh: 我不是笨蛋。
sents.p: wǒ bù shì bèn dàn
sents.en: I'm not stupid.

sents.zh: 她没像你那样有耐心。
sents.p: tā méi xiàng nǐ nà yàng yǒu nài xīn
sents.en: She doesn't have as much patience as you do.

sents.zh: 她非常周到和耐心。
sents.p: tā fēi cháng zhōu dào hé nài xīn
sents.en: She is very thoughtful and patient.

sents.zh: 儿童应该远离河流。有危险。
sents.p: ér tóng yīng gāi yuǎn lí hé liú yǒu wēi xiǎn
sents.en: Children should keep away from the river. It's dangerous.

sents.zh: 你觉得我是在开玩笑吗？
sents.p: nǐ jué de wǒ shì zài kāi wán xiào ma
sents.en: Do you think I'm joking?

sents.zh: 这不是一件开玩笑的事。
sents.p: zhè bù shì yī jiàn kāi wán xiào de shì
sents.en: This isn't a joking matter.

sents.zh: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。
sents.p: xiǎng xiàng lì yǐng xiǎng zhe wǒ men shēng huó de gè gè fāng miàn
sents.en: Imagination affects every part of our lives.

ex.zh: 我敲门，但是没有人回应。

ex.zh: 不知是谁在敲门。
ex.p: bù zhī shì shéi zài qiāo mén
ex.en: Someone is knocking on the door.

ex.zh: 睡过头不是迟到的理由。
ex.p: shuì guò tóu bù shì chí dào de lǐ yóu
ex.en: Over-sleeping is no excuse for being late.

ex.zh: 他担心他可能会迟到。
ex.p: tā dān xīn tā kě néng huì chí dào
ex.en: He's afraid that he might be late.

ex.zh: 他是个好脾气的人。
ex.p: tā shì gè hǎo pí qi de rén
ex.en: He is a pleasant person.

ex.zh: 她脾气有点坏。
ex.p: tā pí qi yǒu diǎn huài
ex.en: She has a bit of a bad temper.

items.en: to be worried; to be distressed
joke; jest; to laugh at; to mock

ex.zh: 我爱听有关动物的笑话。
ex.p: wǒ ài tīng yǒu guān dòng wù de xiào hua
ex.en: I love jokes about animals.

ex.zh: 我没弄明白这个笑话。
ex.p: wǒ méi nòng míng bai zhè gè xiào hua
ex.en: I don't get the joke.

ex.zh: 我太太很容易就会着凉。
ex.p: wǒ tài tai hěn róng yì jiù huì zháo liáng
ex.en: My wife catches colds easily.

ex.zh: 小心不要着凉。
ex.p: xiǎo xīn bù yào zháo liáng
ex.en: Take care not to catch a cold.

ex.zh: 我和平常一样起得早。
ex.p: wǒ hé píng cháng yī yàng qǐ de zǎo
ex.en: I got up early as usual.

ex.zh: 我比平常晚到。
ex.p: wǒ bǐ píng cháng wǎn dào
ex.en: I arrived later than usual.

ex.zh: 这是个文字游戏。
ex.p: zhè shì gè wén zì yóu xì
ex.en: This is a pun.

ex.zh: 本来这间房间里没有家具。
ex.p: běn lái zhè jiān fáng jiān lǐ méi yǒu jiā jù
ex.en: The room originally had no furniture.

ex.zh: 用优质材料做的家具卖得很好。
ex.p: yòng yōu zhì cái liào zuò de jiā jù mài de hěn hǎo
ex.en: Furniture made of good materials sells well.

items.en: classifier for trees, cabbages, plants etc

ex.zh: 以前我家前面有棵大松树。
ex.p: yǐ qián wǒ jiā qián miàn yǒu kē dà sōng shù
ex.en: There used to be a big pine tree in front of my house.

ex.zh: 谁种了这棵树？
ex.p: shéi zhǒng le zhè kē shù
ex.en: Who planted this tree?

ex.zh: 别这么粗心！
ex.p: bié zhè me cū xīn
ex.en: Don't be so careless!

ex.zh: 你今天午餐吃什么？
ex.p: nǐ jīn tiān wǔ cān chī shén me
ex.en: What will you have for lunch today?

ex.zh: 要一起吃午餐吗？
ex.p: yào yī qǐ chī wǔ cān ma
ex.en: Would you like to eat lunch together?

ex.zh: 稍微冷一点没关系。
ex.p: shāo wēi lěng yī diǎn méi guān xi
ex.en: I don't mind if it's a little cold.

ex.zh: 稍微冷点儿不要紧。
ex.p: shāo wēi lěng diǎn ér bù yào jǐn
ex.en: I don't care if it's a bit cold.

ex.zh: 他开始出汗了。
ex.p: tā kāi shǐ chū hàn le
ex.en: He began to sweat.

ex.zh: 我正流着汗。
ex.p: wǒ zhèng liú zhe hàn
ex.en: I'm dripping with sweat.

ex.zh: 水是生命所不可缺少的。
ex.p: shuǐ shì shēng mìng suǒ bù kě quē shǎo de
ex.en: Water is essential to life.

ex.zh: 我的家乡非常漂亮。
ex.p: wǒ de jiā xiāng fēi cháng piào liang
ex.en: My hometown is very pretty.

ex.zh: 一些人通过阅读来放松。
ex.p: yī xiē rén tōng guò yuè dú lái fàng sōng
ex.en: Some people relax by reading.

ex.zh: 我一点都不喜欢阅读。
ex.p: wǒ yī diǎn dōu bù xǐ huan yuè dú
ex.en: I don't like reading at all.

ex.zh: 大多数学生步行去学校。

Education and learning

units.title: Education and learning
units.intro: Grammar focus: 不仅…还; 甚至; 否则

ex.zh: 她没有任何亲戚朋友照顾她。
ex.p: tā méi yǒu rèn hé qīn qi péng you zhào gu tā
ex.en: She doesn't have any friends or relatives to take care of her.

ex.zh: 我常常访问我的亲戚。
ex.p: wǒ cháng cháng fǎng wèn wǒ de qīn qi
ex.en: I often visit my relatives.

ex.zh: 我做钢琴调音师很多年了。
ex.p: wǒ zuò gāng qín diào yīn shī hěn duō nián le
ex.en: I worked as a piano tuner for many years.

ex.zh: 我妹妹每周上两次钢琴课。
ex.p: wǒ mèi mei měi zhōu shàng liǎng cì gāng qín kè
ex.en: My sister takes piano lessons twice a week.

ex.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
ex.p: diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
ex.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.

ex.zh: 我没力气了。
ex.p: wǒ méi lì qi le
ex.en: I have no strength.

ex.zh: 我没力气继续尝试了。
ex.p: wǒ méi lì qi jì xù cháng shì le
ex.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.

ex.zh: 他永远不会打败我的。
ex.p: tā yǒng yuǎn bù huì dǎ bài wǒ de
ex.en: He'll never beat me.

items.en: to go on holidays; to spend one's vacation

ex.zh: 你认为你会到哪儿度假？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi nǐ huì dào nǎr dù jià
ex.en: Where do you suppose you'll spend your vacation?

ex.zh: 我今年没时间去度假。
ex.p: wǒ jīn nián méi shí jiān qù dù jià
ex.en: I don't have time for a vacation this year.

ex.zh: 老虎吃什么东西？
ex.p: lǎo hǔ chī shén me dōng xi
ex.en: What do tigers eat?

ex.zh: 这不是老虎。
ex.p: zhè bù shì lǎo hǔ
ex.en: This isn't a tiger.

ex.zh: 停车场是免费的。
ex.p: tíng chē chǎng shì miǎn fèi de
ex.en: The parking lot is free of charge.

ex.zh: 他以前是个诚实的人。
ex.p: tā yǐ qián shì gè chéng shí de rén
ex.en: He was an honest man.

ex.zh: 我认为她是一个诚实的女人。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi tā shì yī gè chéng shí de nǚ rén
ex.en: I think she's an honest woman.

ex.zh: 你觉得这件毛衣怎么样？
ex.p: nǐ jué de zhè jiàn máo yī zěn me yàng
ex.en: What do you think of this sweater?

ex.zh: 请问下，这件毛衣要多少钱？
ex.p: qǐng wèn xià zhè jiàn máo yī yào duō shǎo qián
ex.en: Excuse me, how much is this sweater?

ex.zh: 童年时我会去海里游泳。
ex.p: tóng nián shí wǒ huì qù hǎi lǐ yóu yǒng
ex.en: I used to go swimming in the sea when I was a child.

ex.zh: 我的童年很快乐。
ex.p: wǒ de tóng nián hěn kuài lè
ex.en: I had a happy childhood.

ex.zh: 他从中国回来了。
ex.p: tā cóng zhōng guó huí lai le
ex.en: He came back from China.

ex.zh: 从中选一个。
ex.p: cóng zhōng xuǎn yī gè
ex.en: Choose one from among these.

ex.zh: 我每周末都会去市区。
ex.p: wǒ měi zhōu mò dū huì qù shì qū
ex.en: I go into town every weekend.

ex.zh: 我一月份要参加考试。
ex.p: wǒ yī yuè fèn yào cān jiā kǎo shì
ex.en: I'm taking an exam in January.

ex.zh: 六七月份雨很多。
ex.p: liù qī yuè fèn yù hěn duō
ex.en: We have a lot of rain in June and July.

ex.zh: 我到旅馆的时候，天已经黑了。
ex.p: wǒ dào lǚ guǎn de shí hou tiān yǐ jīng hēi le
ex.en: It was dark when I reached the hotel.

ex.zh: 你知道这家旅馆吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào zhè jiā lǚ guǎn ma
ex.en: Do you know that hotel?

HSK 4 · 第65单元

Education and learning

Grammar focus: 不仅…还; 甚至; 否则

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 她没有任何亲戚朋友照顾她。
sents.p: tā méi yǒu rèn hé qīn qi péng you zhào gu tā
sents.en: She doesn't have any friends or relatives to take care of her.

sents.zh: 我常常访问我的亲戚。
sents.p: wǒ cháng cháng fǎng wèn wǒ de qīn qi
sents.en: I often visit my relatives.

sents.zh: 我做钢琴调音师很多年了。
sents.p: wǒ zuò gāng qín diào yīn shī hěn duō nián le
sents.en: I worked as a piano tuner for many years.

sents.zh: 我妹妹每周上两次钢琴课。
sents.p: wǒ mèi mei měi zhōu shàng liǎng cì gāng qín kè
sents.en: My sister takes piano lessons twice a week.

sents.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
sents.p: diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
sents.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.

sents.zh: 我没力气了。
sents.p: wǒ méi lì qi le
sents.en: I have no strength.

sents.zh: 我没力气继续尝试了。
sents.p: wǒ méi lì qi jì xù cháng shì le
sents.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.

sents.zh: 他永远不会打败我的。
sents.p: tā yǒng yuǎn bù huì dǎ bài wǒ de
sents.en: He'll never beat me.

sents.zh: 你认为你会到哪儿度假？
sents.p: nǐ rèn wéi nǐ huì dào nǎr dù jià
sents.en: Where do you suppose you'll spend your vacation?

sents.zh: 我今年没时间去度假。
sents.p: wǒ jīn nián méi shí jiān qù dù jià
sents.en: I don't have time for a vacation this year.

sents.zh: 老虎吃什么东西？
sents.p: lǎo hǔ chī shén me dōng xi
sents.en: What do tigers eat?

sents.zh: 这不是老虎。
sents.p: zhè bù shì lǎo hǔ
sents.en: This isn't a tiger.

sents.zh: 停车场是免费的。
sents.p: tíng chē chǎng shì miǎn fèi de
sents.en: The parking lot is free of charge.

sents.zh: 他以前是个诚实的人。
sents.p: tā yǐ qián shì gè chéng shí de rén
sents.en: He was an honest man.

sents.zh: 我认为她是一个诚实的女人。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi tā shì yī gè chéng shí de nǚ rén
sents.en: I think she's an honest woman.

sents.zh: 你觉得这件毛衣怎么样？
sents.p: nǐ jué de zhè jiàn máo yī zěn me yàng
sents.en: What do you think of this sweater?

sents.zh: 请问下，这件毛衣要多少钱？
sents.p: qǐng wèn xià zhè jiàn máo yī yào duō shǎo qián
sents.en: Excuse me, how much is this sweater?

sents.zh: 童年时我会去海里游泳。
sents.p: tóng nián shí wǒ huì qù hǎi lǐ yóu yǒng
sents.en: I used to go swimming in the sea when I was a child.

sents.zh: 我的童年很快乐。
sents.p: wǒ de tóng nián hěn kuài lè
sents.en: I had a happy childhood.

sents.zh: 他从中国回来了。
sents.p: tā cóng zhōng guó huí lai le
sents.en: He came back from China.

sents.zh: 从中选一个。
sents.p: cóng zhōng xuǎn yī gè
sents.en: Choose one from among these.

sents.zh: 我每周末都会去市区。
sents.p: wǒ měi zhōu mò dū huì qù shì qū
sents.en: I go into town every weekend.

sents.zh: 我一月份要参加考试。
sents.p: wǒ yī yuè fèn yào cān jiā kǎo shì
sents.en: I'm taking an exam in January.

sents.zh: 六七月份雨很多。
sents.p: liù qī yuè fèn yù hěn duō
sents.en: We have a lot of rain in June and July.

sents.zh: 我到旅馆的时候，天已经黑了。
sents.p: wǒ dào lǚ guǎn de shí hou tiān yǐ jīng hēi le
sents.en: It was dark when I reached the hotel.

sents.zh: 你知道这家旅馆吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào zhè jiā lǚ guǎn ma
sents.en: Do you know that hotel?

units.title: Travel, culture and nature
units.intro: Grammar focus: 以…为…; 随着; 稍微; a 150-character narrative

ex.zh: “为什么你不来？”“因为我不想。”
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ bù lái yīn wèi wǒ bù xiǎng
ex.en: "Why aren't you going?" "Because I don't want to."

ex.zh: 一个人要为他的行为负责。
ex.p: yī gè rén yào wèi tā de xíng wéi fù zé
ex.en: A man is responsible for his deeds.

ex.zh: 他不再是以前的那个他了。
ex.p: tā bù zài shì yǐ qián de nà gè tā le
ex.en: He is not what he used to be.

ex.zh: 他比以前学得更努力了。
ex.p: tā bǐ yǐ qián xué de gēng nǔ lì le
ex.en: He studies much harder than before.

items.en: to go out; to go away (on a trip etc)

ex.zh: 我曾经每周末都和朋友外出。
ex.p: wǒ céng jīng měi zhōu mò dōu hé péng you wài chū
ex.en: I used to go out with friends every weekend.

ex.zh: 我父亲外出了。
ex.p: wǒ fù qīn wài chū le
ex.en: My father is out.

ex.zh: 我的证件丢了。
ex.p: wǒ de zhèng jiàn diū le
ex.en: I lost my papers.

ex.zh: 这场谈话将要持续三天。
ex.p: zhè chǎng tán huà jiāng yào chí xù sān tiān
ex.en: The talks will last three days.

ex.zh: 我将要去参加会议。
ex.p: wǒ jiāng yào qù cān jiā huì yì
ex.en: I will go to the meeting.

ex.zh: 猫在桌子底下。
ex.p: māo zài zhuō zi dǐ xia
ex.en: The cat is under the table.

ex.zh: 我们晚饭后吃新鲜水果。
ex.p: wǒ men wǎn fàn hòu chī xīn xiān shuǐ guǒ
ex.en: We ate fresh fruit after dinner.

ex.zh: 我想要一些新鲜的鸡蛋。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī xiē xīn xiān de jī dàn
ex.en: I want some fresh eggs.

ex.zh: 他点头以示鼓励。
ex.p: tā diǎn tóu yǐ shì gǔ lì
ex.en: He nodded encouragingly.

ex.zh: 所有人都喜欢偷懒。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu rén dōu xǐ huan tōu lǎn
ex.en: Everybody likes to goof off.

ex.zh: 这个男孩子很懒。
ex.p: zhè gè nán hái zi hěn lǎn
ex.en: This boy is lazy.

items.en: proud of oneself; pleased with oneself

ex.zh: 那个护士人很好，又有礼貌。
ex.p: nà gè hù shi rén hěn hǎo yòu yǒu lǐ mào
ex.en: That nurse is very kind and polite.

ex.zh: 用手指点别人不礼貌。
ex.p: yòng shǒu zhǐ diǎn bié ren bù lǐ mào
ex.en: It's bad manners to point at people.

items.en: singing voice; fig. original voice of a poet

ex.zh: 想吃多少饼干就吃多少。
ex.p: xiǎng chī duō shǎo bǐng gān jiù chī duō shǎo
ex.en: Take as many cookies as you want.

ex.zh: 葡萄酒是用葡萄做成的。
ex.p: pú tao jiǔ shì yòng pú tao zuò chéng de
ex.en: Wine is made from grapes.

ex.zh: 我不喜欢葡萄酒。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan pú tao jiǔ
ex.en: I don't like wine.

items.en: to raise one's head; to gain ground
to search for; to look up

ex.zh: 我得查找一下我的笔。
ex.p: wǒ de chá zhǎo yī xià wǒ de bǐ
ex.en: I need to search for my pen.

units.title: Travel, culture and nature
units.intro: Grammar focus: 以…为…; 随着; 稍微; a 150-character narrative

ex.zh: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。
ex.p: zǒng tǐ shàng shuō rì běn de qì hòu wēn hé
ex.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.

ex.zh: 我对这气候习惯了。
ex.p: wǒ duì zhè qì hòu xí guàn le
ex.en: I'm accustomed to the climate.

ex.zh: 他用毛巾弄干自己。
ex.p: tā yòng máo jīn nòng gàn zì jǐ
ex.en: He dried himself with a towel.

ex.zh: 我再拿块毛巾过来。
ex.p: wǒ zài ná kuài máo jīn guò lái
ex.en: I'll bring one more towel.

items.en: to handle; to transact; to conduct

ex.zh: 这里的人习惯了寒冷。
ex.p: zhè lǐ de rén xí guàn le hán lěng
ex.en: The people here are used to the cold.

ex.zh: 她在一个寒冷的十二月晚上死了。
ex.p: tā zài yī gè hán lěng de shí èr yuè wǎn shang sǐ le
ex.en: She died on a cold night in December.

ex.zh: 我喜欢葡萄酒。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan pú tao jiǔ
ex.en: I like wine.

ex.zh: 葡萄酒是用葡萄做成的。
ex.p: pú tao jiǔ shì yòng pú tao zuò chéng de
ex.en: Wine is made from grapes.

ex.zh: 一般而言，日本人很害羞。
ex.p: yī bān ér yán rì běn rén hěn hài xiū
ex.en: Generally, Japanese people are shy.

ex.zh: 我害羞得不敢正面看她的脸。
ex.p: wǒ hài xiū de bù gǎn zhèng miàn kàn tā de liǎn
ex.en: I was too shy to look her in the face.

ex.zh: 明天他会在月球降落。
ex.p: míng tiān tā huì zài yuè qiú jiàng luò
ex.en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

ex.zh: 我们在树林中迷路了。
ex.p: wǒ men zài shù lín zhōng mí lù le
ex.en: We got lost in the woods.

ex.zh: 我在树林里迷路了。
ex.p: wǒ zài shù lín lǐ mí lù le
ex.en: I got lost in the woods.

ex.zh: 气温突然下降了。
ex.p: qì wēn tū rán xià jiàng le
ex.en: The temperature has suddenly dropped.

ex.zh: 我真的非常期待暑假。
ex.p: wǒ zhēn de fēi cháng qī dài shǔ jià
ex.en: I'm really looking forward to summer vacation.

items.en: not the only one; not only

ex.zh: 我每六小时量一次体温。
ex.p: wǒ měi liù xiǎo shí liàng yī cì tǐ wēn
ex.en: I took my temperature every six hours.

ex.zh: 小孩的体温一般比大人的要高。
ex.p: xiǎo hái de tǐ wēn yī bān bǐ dà ren de yào gāo
ex.en: Children generally have a higher body temperature than adults.

ex.zh: 请给我两杯苹果汁。
ex.p: qǐng gěi wǒ liǎng bēi píng guǒ zhī
ex.en: Two glasses of apple juice, please.

ex.zh: 我想要果汁。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào guǒ zhī
ex.en: I would like fruit juice.

ex.zh: 厨师每天准备不同的菜。
ex.p: chú shī měi tiān zhǔn bèi bù tóng de cài
ex.en: The cook prepares different dishes every day.

ex.zh: 我们有一位非常好的厨师。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu yī wèi fēi cháng hǎo de chú shī
ex.en: We have a very good chef.

ex.zh: 要住在郊区的话，汽车是必需的。
ex.p: yào zhù zài jiāo qū de huà qì chē shì bì xū de
ex.en: A car is a must for life in the suburbs.

ex.zh: 我们住在郊区。
ex.p: wǒ men zhù zài jiāo qū
ex.en: We live in the suburbs.

ex.zh: 这样做你能节约几个小时。
ex.p: zhè yàng zuò nǐ néng jié yuē jǐ gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.

ex.zh: 请节约用电。
ex.p: qǐng jié yuē yòng diàn
ex.en: Please save electricity.

items.en: to greet sb by word or action

ex.zh: 他有点活泼。
ex.p: tā yǒu diǎn huó po
ex.en: He's a bit lively.

ex.zh: 今天比昨天暖和。
ex.p: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān nuǎn huo
ex.en: It is warmer today than yesterday.

ex.zh: 去年冬天很暖和。

sents.zh: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。
sents.p: zǒng tǐ shàng shuō rì běn de qì hòu wēn hé

sents.zh: 我对这气候习惯了。

sents.zh: 他用毛巾弄干自己。
sents.p: tā yòng máo jīn nòng gàn zì jǐ

sents.zh: 我再拿块毛巾过来。
sents.p: wǒ zài ná kuài máo jīn guò lái
sents.en: I'll bring one more towel.

sents.zh: 这里的人习惯了寒冷。
sents.p: zhè lǐ de rén xí guàn le hán lěng
sents.en: The people here are used to the cold.

sents.zh: 她在一个寒冷的十二月晚上死了。
sents.p: tā zài yī gè hán lěng de shí èr yuè wǎn shang sǐ le
sents.en: She died on a cold night in December.

sents.zh: 我喜欢葡萄酒。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan pú tao jiǔ
sents.en: I like wine.

sents.zh: 葡萄酒是用葡萄做成的。
sents.p: pú tao jiǔ shì yòng pú tao zuò chéng de
sents.en: Wine is made from grapes.

sents.zh: 一般而言，日本人很害羞。
sents.p: yī bān ér yán rì běn rén hěn hài xiū
sents.en: Generally, Japanese people are shy.

sents.zh: 我害羞得不敢正面看她的脸。
sents.p: wǒ hài xiū de bù gǎn zhèng miàn kàn tā de liǎn
sents.en: I was too shy to look her in the face.

sents.zh: 明天他会在月球降落。
sents.p: míng tiān tā huì zài yuè qiú jiàng luò
sents.en: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

sents.zh: 我们在树林中迷路了。
sents.p: wǒ men zài shù lín zhōng mí lù le
sents.en: We got lost in the woods.

sents.zh: 我在树林里迷路了。
sents.p: wǒ zài shù lín lǐ mí lù le
sents.en: I got lost in the woods.

sents.zh: 气温突然下降了。
sents.p: qì wēn tū rán xià jiàng le
sents.en: The temperature has suddenly dropped.

sents.zh: 我真的非常期待暑假。
sents.p: wǒ zhēn de fēi cháng qī dài shǔ jià
sents.en: I'm really looking forward to summer vacation.

sents.zh: 我每六小时量一次体温。
sents.p: wǒ měi liù xiǎo shí liàng yī cì tǐ wēn
sents.en: I took my temperature every six hours.

sents.zh: 小孩的体温一般比大人的要高。
sents.p: xiǎo hái de tǐ wēn yī bān bǐ dà ren de yào gāo
sents.en: Children generally have a higher body temperature than adults.

sents.zh: 请给我两杯苹果汁。
sents.p: qǐng gěi wǒ liǎng bēi píng guǒ zhī
sents.en: Two glasses of apple juice, please.

sents.zh: 我想要果汁。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào guǒ zhī
sents.en: I would like fruit juice.

sents.zh: 厨师每天准备不同的菜。
sents.p: chú shī měi tiān zhǔn bèi bù tóng de cài
sents.en: The cook prepares different dishes every day.

sents.zh: 我们有一位非常好的厨师。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu yī wèi fēi cháng hǎo de chú shī
sents.en: We have a very good chef.

sents.zh: 要住在郊区的话，汽车是必需的。
sents.p: yào zhù zài jiāo qū de huà qì chē shì bì xū de
sents.en: A car is a must for life in the suburbs.

sents.zh: 我们住在郊区。
sents.p: wǒ men zhù zài jiāo qū
sents.en: We live in the suburbs.

sents.zh: 这样做你能节约几个小时。
sents.p: zhè yàng zuò nǐ néng jié yuē jǐ gè xiǎo shí
sents.en: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.

sents.zh: 请节约用电。
sents.p: qǐng jié yuē yòng diàn
sents.en: Please save electricity.

sents.zh: 他有点活泼。
sents.p: tā yǒu diǎn huó po
sents.en: He's a bit lively.

sents.zh: 今天比昨天暖和。
sents.p: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān nuǎn huo
sents.en: It is warmer today than yesterday.

sents.zh: 去年冬天很暖和。
sents.p: qù nián dōng tiān hěn nuǎn huo
sents.en: We had a mild winter last year.

sents.zh: 你们该养成使用字典的习惯。
sents.p: nǐ men gāi yǎng chéng shǐ yòng zì diǎn de xí guàn
sents.en: You should try to form the habit of using your dictionaries.

sents.zh: 你到了该去理发的时候了。
sents.p: nǐ dào le gāi qù lǐ fà de shí hou le
sents.en: It is time you had a haircut!

sents.zh: 你去哪儿了？我去了理发店。
sents.p: nǐ qù nǎr le wǒ qù le lǐ fà diàn
sents.en: "Where have you been?" "I've been to the barber's."

sents.zh: 这个句子在语法上是正确的。
sents.p: zhè gè jù zi zài yǔ fǎ shàng shì zhèng què de
sents.en: This sentence is grammatically correct.

sents.zh: 语法是很复杂的。
sents.p: yǔ fǎ shì hěn fù zá de
sents.en: Grammar is a very complex thing.

sents.zh: 我现在在打排球。
sents.p: wǒ xiàn zài zài dǎ pái qiú
sents.en: I'm playing volleyball now.

sents.zh: 有些人喜欢排球，其他人喜欢网球。
sents.p: yǒu xiē rén xǐ huan pái qiú qí tā rén xǐ huan wǎng qiú
sents.en: Some people like volleyball, others enjoy tennis.
